characters.name: Suzaku Kururugi
characters.description: Therival and best friendof Lelouch, a soldier serving the empire. While Lelouch rebels against Britannia and seeks to destroy it entirely to liberate Japan, Suzakuseeks to change it from within, even if it means having to stand against his own countrymen to do so, and even despite the fact that said empire actively discriminates against him and his people. He's an idealist, with his prevailing belief being that the endsdo notjustify the means, and he continually crosses paths with and opposes the Black Knights because of this. He usually overwhelms them with the powerfulLancelot, often going up against Kallen and her Guren, who serves as Suzaku's main rival on the battlefield. That his best friend Lelouch is also his greatest opponent in Zero is the main driving conflict between the two throughout the whole show, and at the end of the first season, he discovers the truth, but he still maintains his ideals. After the first season, he joins the Knights of the Round as the Knight of Seven, hoping to advance to the rank of Knight of One, which would grant him honorary rule of any area, with his goal being to rule over Area 11 (Japan) and use his position to help the Japanese people. Ace Pilot: His natural talent and superior physical capabilities allow him to pilot theLancelot, which no one had been able to pilot before. Along with Kallen, he's arguably the best in the series. All for Nothing:When his father planned to encourage the Japanese people to fight to the bitter end during Britannia's original assault on the country, he killed him in order to force a surrender before what he saw to be a massive amount of unnecessary death could occur. However, as he himself admits in the opening narration of R2 Episode 20, his plan failed. Japan's immediately surrendering didn't stop constant warfare, and ironically his letting Japan be given over to Britannia before the other world powers could potentially get involved likely only resulted in a greater net total of lost lives.

characters.name: C.C.
characters.description: A mysterious, snarky girl who makes a contract with Lelouch and grants him the power of Geass. In truth, C.C. is an immortal witch who has lived for centuries, and has an apparent connection to Lelouch's fallen mother Marianne. She knows a lot more than she lets on, often muses on the nature of humanity due to her long lived nature, and remains at Lelouch's side as he plans to obliterate Britannia and change the world's order. Abusive Mom: C.C. is not literally Mao's parent, but he was six when C.C. made a contract with him and, due to the nature of his Geass, subsequently became his only human connection. It'sAll There in the Manualthat when he was with C.C. she would take him out in public,Geass and all, alas when his Geass began to go out of control and while C.C.'s voice was the only thing that could stop the madness in his head (his Geass allowing him to hear everyone's thoughts) she abandoned him, resulting in him looking for years in years and having turned, well, batshit crazy due to Geass effects. Action Girl: She doesn't do much actual fighting (it's not her fight, after all) but she's perfectly capable of it. While not on the same level asKallen, she is quite an adept Knightmare Frame pilot, serving as Lelouch's copilot and once able to hold her own with limited support in a chaotic air battle against Suzaku, amongst others. She's also handy with guns and skilled in hand-to-hand combat. InNightmare Of Nunnally, it's revealed that she fought in the Hundred Years War, andJoan of Arcwas her rival back then. Adaptational Villainy: Her appearance in theLost StoriesRoute Entanglement"Stairway to Harmony".She silently cuts her contract with Lelouch once theSAZpicks up steam, feeling he is no longer capable in fulfilling his end of the deal. What crosses her into villainy is that she runs back toCharlesto help him activate the Ragnarök Connection, meaning she had a direct hand in killing everyone in that timeline just to fulfil her ownDeath Seekertendencies. characters.name: Kallen Kozuki / Kallen Stadtfeld
characters.description: Half-Britannian, half-Japanese, fully dedicated to liberating Japan from Britannia's rule of oppression, Kallen is anAce Pilotand fights alongside with the Black Knights as Zero's personal bodyguard. Like Lelouch, she also struggles with living a double life as the sickly, soft spoken Britannian Kallen Stadtfeld, and the hot blooded Japanese freedom fighter Kallen Kouzuki. She also struggles with facing the different sides of Lelouch, valuing the ideals of Zero above all. She is the only pilot skilled enough to pilot the Guren, whose Radiant Wave Surger is able to completely melt opposing Knightmare Frames. Ace Pilot: Kallen is an extremely skilled Knightmare Frame pilot, rivaling the abilities of even the Knights of Rounds. She's acknowledged as the ace pilot of the Black Knights by enemies and allies alike.She even destroyed Suzaku's Lancelot Albion in their final confrontation, which arguably makes her the best pilot in the series. Action Girl: Kallen often kicks lots of ass while piloting the Guren. Adopted into Royalty: Because her biological father's wife could not bear children, Kallen was adopted into her noble father's household. All Is Well That Ends Well: It's surprising how quickly she's willing to forgiveLelouchfor everything he puts her and her friends through during the Zero Requiem. She also forgivesCornelia and the other Britannians for being evil towards her race, and the other Black Knights for trying to kill both her and Lelouch,whichconvinced Lelouchto put her through the former in the first place.

characters.name: Nunnally Lamperouge / Princess Nunnally vi Britannia
characters.description: The daughter of Emperor Charles and his consort Marianne, as well as Lelouch's younger sister. The messy death of her mother left her not only contained in a wheelchair but also blind out of the trauma of having her mom bleeding all over her and dying. She's shown as a sweet, gentle girl who attends Ashford Academy's middle school and serves as Lelouch'sMorality Chain. Lelouch is trying to overthrow the entire world's order for her sake, no matter the cost. InNightmare of Nunnally, she is the main protagonist, who receives a Geass that allows her to see the future and an alternate personality derived from her anger and other negative emotions that can move and pilot a Knightmare Frame. She initially sets out to find Lelouch, but also expands her goal to stopping the bloodshed between Britannians and the Japanese. Abdicate the Throne: Per Lelouch of the Resurrection,she has given up being Empress instead serving as a major political figure of Britannia likely to please the UFN who wants former royalty to not have too much power. Adaptational Jerkass: She's still largely the same sweet girl we know her as in the main series, but her alternate self from theNightmare of Nunnallyseries is more openly angry and vindictive towards the misfortunes she and Lelouch suffered in their backstory, though this only gets brought into the forefront after she thought she also lost Lelouch during the Shinjuku Ghetto incident. After she contracts with Nemo, she attacks every Knightmare Frame on sight until she has her sword pointed at Clovis's face, though she stops herself at the last minute. Affectionate Nickname: Like her brother who is nicknamed "Lulu", she is nicknamed "Nunna" by Shirley.

characters.name: Rolo Haliburton / Rolo Lamperouge
characters.description: A socially awkward student of Ashford Academy, he's introduced in R2 to serve as Lelouch's false younger brother after everyone was givenFake Memoriesat the hands of the Emperor's Geass. He was raised by the Geass Order to be aTyke-Bomb, and is actually an assassin that's tasked to kill Lelouch if he steps out of line. That is of course, until Lelouch manages to bring him into the throes of war as well. Ace Pilot: He fights evenly with V.V. for a while and evendamagesthe Siegfried (one of the most powerful mechas in the show) without the help of his Geass. All things considered, this establishes him as a shockingly capable pilot. Adaptational Nice Guy: He's a lot nicer in theCompilation Moviecontinuity. He doesn'tkill Shirleythanks to Jeremiah sendingher home, nor does he casually execute the kids from the Geass Order. In fact, the only people he’s ever shown killing are a few Britannian soldiers. As a result, it makes Lelouch's attempt at killing him and subsequent outburst come across as more cold-hearted, simply detesting him for not being Nunnally.In the manga, he doesn’t kill the Black Knight member he saves from the Geass Order children after the former questions about his relation to them. Adaptational Villainy: InNightmare of Nunnally, he's a straight-up villain instead of aNominal Hero.

characters.name: #-B
characters.description: 0% Approval Rating:Invoked. He makes himself so hated as Emperor that when the Zero Requiem happens, everyone will unite behind his killer and focus on doing things in the exact opposite way Lelouch did simply because they hate him that much. Ace Custom: Has three over the course of the series:His first is actually a subversion: it is a Burai, the same type Knightmare Frame used by the rank-and-file pilots of the Black Knights, with an extra head ornament.Later, he hijacks the Gawain, an experimental Knightmare Frame outfitted with its own Float System, making it the first KF capable of flight; personal Hadron Cannons that have a short and wide range at first, but are perfected with Rakshata's help; and the "Druid System", originally meant for studying the ruins on Shikine Island, which can be used to predict enemy troop movement.In R2, he gets his own personal Knightmare Frame, the Shinkiro. Using a non-standard control system that plays to his strengths as a tactician, the Shinkiro has aChest Blasterthat can fire over a wide range and aBeehive Barrierthat requires manual input via a keyboard interface that allows it pinpoint protection over any part of its body.Lost Storiesreveals that Kyoto was working on a Guren-derivative for him to pilot called the Zero Kagero. characters.name: Rozé
characters.description: The current princess of the United States of Japan who assumed the alias Rozé following Neo Britannia's invasion of Hokkaido. As Rozé, she is part of the Nameless Mercenary duo and acts as the younger brother of Ash while her friend and lookalike Sakura assumes her role as a double. Ace Custom: Gains a specialized Knightmare Frame for herself known as Artemis, which is notable for being a flying Knightmare, which she intends to use to support Ash on the frontlines without having to ride in his Zi-Apollo. Affectionate Nickname: Sakura calls her "Sa-Chan". All for Nothing:She's horrified upon realizing that brainwashing Ash upon their first meeting was very literally pointless, as he'd sworn to protect her all along to honor her deceased father's wishes, and worse still, she was masquerading as his little brother after his real little brother was murdered. Aloof Dark-Haired Girl:Downplayed. She wears a short blonde wig around her allies for most of the series, despite her real hair underneath being long and dark. Sakuya is so busy planning on rescuing Sakura and liberating Hokkaido from Neo-Britannia, combined with her higher status as a princess above her peers that she barely has time to hang out with the other teens in her age group among the Seven Shining Stars. However, she never acts cold or mean toward them—she is just incredibly focused on her mission.

characters.name: Ash Phoenix
characters.description: The other half of the Nameless Mercenary duo, acting as Rozé's older brother. 13 Is Unlucky: He's revealed to be the former Knight of Thirteen and his life has been full of hardships and misfortune. Ace Pilot: He's highly skilled at piloting Knightmare Frames. And I Must Scream:It's implied he's at least somewhat aware of the fact he's been brainwashed into being Sakuya's minion if his stricken expression and sweating as he recalls Sakuya Geassing him is any indication. Unfortunately, there's nothing he can do about it and he only seems partially aware of it at all when Sakuya prods him over his loyalty. Animal Lover: He often rescues stray cats and dogs, and gives them shelter in the trailer where he and Rozé live while putting them up for adoption.

characters.name: Rakshata Chawla
characters.description: A mild-mannered engineer from India, Rakshata Chawla leads the research team of the Black Knights.Used to work withLloyd Asplund and Cécile Croomy. Bare Midriffs Are Feminine: A beautifulBollywood Nerdwho typically leaves her stomach exposed. Bollywood Nerd: She's aMad Scientistfrom India and her appearance and other characteristics contrast her rivals, who appear quite British. Brilliant, but Lazy: The audience will be hard pressed to find a time when she is NOT laying down on a sofa, even on the bridge of a ship in the middle of battle. Fairy Tale Motifs: Plays the role of the Caterpillar inNunnally in Wonderland.

characters.name: Kaguya Sumeragi
characters.description: Kaguya Sumeragi (皇 神楽耶, Sumeragi Kaguya), fourteen years old (fifteen inR2), is the young head mistress of the Kyōto House and a supporter of the Black Knights. She is also a close friend of Empress Tianzi of China. Despite her age and physique, she possesses a strong will and is highly influential amongst the Houses. Kaguya has admired Zero since his debut, and wishes to have his hand in marriage. All There in the Manual: HerForgotten First Meetingwith Lelouch only appears in theAudio Play"Kaguya Sumeragi, Deceived by a Demon" (Sumeragi Kaguya Oni Au). Arranged Marriage: Was to be engaged to her cousin Suzaku. Ascended Extra: Despite appearing by herself in the very first opening even, Kaguya doesn't actually do much of anything in the entire first season. She gains a fair amount more prominence in season 2as theSole Survivorof her house. Bathing Beauty: In theLelouch of the Re;surrectionPicture Drama, she joins the other girls in the bath house.

characters.name: Shinichirō Tamaki
characters.description: Shinichirō Tamaki (玉城 真一郎, Tamaki Shin'ichirō), twenty-four years old (twenty-five inR2), and is the leader of the second special squadron of the Black Knights. He is a hot-headed and carefree person, quick to cheer others on when not doing the fighting but rash and impulsive when he's on the front lines. His rashness is shown to border on recklessness, as he orders the execution of the Ashford Academy student council against Zero's wishes, though extenuating circumstances prevent his orders from being carried out. He pilots a standard Knightmare Frame during battles, though he rarely lasts long before being forced to eject. Ascended Extra: He's playable inSuper Robot Wars Z2, where his Burai can resupply allied units. Brick Joke: Remember when Tamaki was harassing Zero about giving him an official position in the Black Knights during R2? Well, it takes a few episodes of waiting and a sharp eye during the UNF ratification ceremony, but we finally find out what position he got:Internal Cleaning Supporter. Yup, he's a glorified janitor. Butt-Monkey: In Lelouch's personal stats for the Black Knights, Tamaki comes out with the lowest rankings at 40, ten in each category (Intelligence, Combat Ability, Charisma, and Loyalty). Note that, with the exception of non-combatants, who have no Combat Ability score, and Nagisa Chiba, who ties for Loyalty, his scores are worse than any other member. Moreover, every other member ranksat leastpast 150, if just barely in some cases. While at first this might seem a joke at his expense, it fits if you take a look at his track record over the course of the show. It's aRunning Gagthat his mech will be destroyed before he can do anything meaningful in a fight.Consider also that C. C., who has loved grilling him from time to time, composed that list. characters.name: Kaname Ohgi
characters.description: Twenty-six years old (twenty-seven inR2), Ohgi used to be a school teacher before he became the leader of a Japanese resistance cell, having taken over after the death of Kallen Kozuki's older brother Naoto. Or at least, Ohgiwasthe leader, until Zero butts in. Adaptational Heroism:In theR2anime, Ohgi makes a deal with Schneizel in backstabbing Lelouch without a second thought. In the third film, he begs Lelouch to tell the truth first before Rolo (in the Shinkiro) interfered.Re;surrectionconfirms that he did regret his decisions, but Lelouch still snaps him out of committing suicide, showing him there are no hard feelings. Ambiguously Jewish: He has curly hair and his casual clothes have a Star of David on them. Anti-Hero:Knight in Sour Armor->Unscrupulous Hero(withthe betrayal).That is, unless you consider the thirdCompilation MovieandRe;surrection, where he remains in the former category. The Complainer Is Always Wrong: In the third recap movie,he and the Black Knights refuse to open fire on Lelouch until he truthfully answers them, objecting to Schneizel's men preparing to do so anyway. They of course don't listen, but Rolo once again comes to the rescue.

characters.name: Diethard Ried
characters.description: Britannian TV producer who joined the Black Knights not because he believed in their cause but because he worshiped Zero. He was in charge of the Black Knights information, espionage, and public relations. Amoral Attorney: He's a law school graduate (as seen in hisin-series profile), but ended up working in Britannia'sPropaganda Machine. Ascended Fanboy: His reaction to Zero was virtually the opposite of how most Britannians view him, having admired him on an obsessive level. Naturally, he joined the Black Knights as soon as he was able. Asshole Victim:Dies at Lelouch's hand from a gunshot, instead of his Geass like he wanted. Ax-Crazy: While he may not be stark raving mad like say Luciano or Mao, he's actually one of the most bloodthirsty characters in the series as his whole modus operandi for joining is to cause as much death and destruction to entertain himself.

characters.name: Kyoshiro Tohdoh
characters.description: A 37-year old colonel from the Japan Liberation Front, he is renowned as "Tohdoh of Miracles" because of his famous miracle at Itsukushima where he caused the invading Britannian army their only defeat,withoutthe use of any knightmares. In addition to his skill at strategic planning, he's a supreme knightmare pilot. Joins the Black Knights along with the Four Holy Swords after being rescued from prison (having been captured after the death of his superior, General Katase), becoming field commander of the Black Knights' military forces. The Ace: Though not to Xingke's extent, he's still a great strategist and a very talented pilot. In Lelouch's stats for the Black Knights, he has the highest total stats of all of them, with 345 out of 400 on a 0-100 scale in four perimeters. In comparison, the second-highest score is Kaguya, with 270. Badass Longcoat: His default appearance is wearing an Imperial-style military coat, one that he shares with the equally badass Four Swords. Badass Normal: One of the best strategists in the world and a major threat on the battlefield due to his immense skill as a Knightmare pilot despite having a mid-tier Frame (The most powerful Knightmare he gets to use is the Zangetsu which, while powerful, does not match up to the Rounds Customs or the Lancelot), despite having no special traits besides having more combat experience than 90% of the show's combatants. Badass Teacher: This is the guy who made Suzaku into the warrior he is today.

characters.name: The Four Holy Swords
characters.description: The Japan Liberation Front's most powerful soldiers led by Tohdoh. After Tohdoh is captured by the Britannians, they seek out the Black Knights for aid in rescuing him. They subsequently join fully with the Black Knights after Tohdoh does. Cannot Spit It Out: Chiba's crush on Tohdoh.Not exactly a secret among the Black Knights, though. Chainsaw Good: Their knightmares' signature weapons are chainsawkatanas. Dwindling Party: Starting in R2, they start to drop.First Urabe sacrifices himself to save Lelouch, then Senba is killed by Gino and finally Asahina dies when the first FLEIJA is detonated. This leaves just Chiba out of the four alive by the end. Elite Four: The Four Holy Swords are essentially Tohdoh's equivalent of the Four Heavenly Kings.

characters.name: Kento Sugiyama
characters.description: A member of Naoto Kazuki's resistance team before joining The Black Knights. He serves as a Special Division Captain. Ace Pilot: One of the top pilots among the Black Knights, Zero rates him as (a distant) second to Kallen among the former members of Naoto's group. Chivalrous Pervert: According to Chiba inTurn 12.59Picture Drama, Sugiyama is a "total skirt-chaser." The Captain: Of the Special Division once the Knights join the UFN.

characters.name: Yoshitaka Minami
characters.description: A member of Naoto Kazuki's resistance team before joining The Black Knights. He became the commander of The Black Knight's First Secret Corps. Covert Pervert: According to Rakshata inTurn 12.59Picture Drama, Minami is a lolicon.InRe;surrection, the only scenes where he shows up has him standing in the background watching a group of young girls. InRe;surrection, the only scenes where he shows up has him standing in the background watching a group of young girls. Curtains Match the Window: Purple hair and purple eyes. The Quiet One: Minami is much more quiet and less prone to saying anything compared to his comrades.

characters.name: Kinoshita
characters.description: A Black Knight who helps lead Lelouch's raid on the Geass Order, and is deeply troubled after witnessing the massacre. Almost Dead Guy: He survives his injuries just long enough to reveal Lelouch's actions to Asahina. Everyone Has Standards: He thought the Geass Order was a military target and is appalled to see civilians being slaughtered. He even questions Lelouch and claims there must have been a mistake, but Lelouch orders him to go through with it. Guilt-Ridden Accomplice: His complicity in the massacre and being ordered not to tell other Black Knights about it weighs on his conscience. Hope Spot: He ejects from his Knightmare when it explodes, but he's then shot multiple times by a nearby Britannian pilot.

characters.name: Naomi Inoue
characters.description: A member of Naoto Kazuki's resistance team before joining The Black Knights. She served as a commander providing logistical support. Action Girl: Downplayed, as she spend most of her time in the moreBoring, but Practicalrole of logistics and leadership. Her frontline actions are mostly as ground reconnaisance support, and she almost never seen piloting a Knightmare unlike Kallen. Armored Coffins:Got blown up in her mech during the Black Rebellion, which exploded before she can even properly react. Mauve Shirt: Despite being one of the original Black Knights, her name was not even mentioned by anyone,except by Sugiyama after her explosive demise. Mysterious Past: TheRed Tracksnovels notice that no one knows a thing about her past. Ohgi suspect that even her name is likely a fake one.

characters.name: Toru Yoshida
characters.description: A member of Naoto Kazuki's resistance team before joining The Black Knights. He served as a soldier under the command of Ohgi. Armored Coffins: Much like Naomi above, he's killed while piloting his mecha, courtesy of Suzaku during the Black Rebellion. Mauve Shirt: He is one of the original Black Knights, but he doesn't really have much characterization beyond that before he dies. Sacrificial Lamb: A longer lived example than most. Killed off by Suzaku to display how severeEuphie's deathhas broken the former, to the point where he now breaks hisThou Shalt Not Killprinciple.

characters.name: Shiro Sazanami
characters.description: The Black Knights' general in charge of coordinating the liberation of Hokkaido from Neo-Britannia. Alliterative Name:ShiroSazanami. Reasonable Authority Figure:In Episode 10, he tells his men to put their guns down after he sees Narah saving one of his men from the L.O.K.I. drone, realizing that she's not responsible for the attack. Secret-Keeper: He is among the few who know that Rozé is Sakuya and informs Cornelia about it given that she's her niece.

characters.name: Kaoru Shizuka
characters.description: A member of the Black Knights at the Hachinohe Base and a subordinate to Shiro Sazanami. Number Two: He's the main aide of Sazanami. Secret-Keeper: He is among the few who know that Rozé is Sakuya.

characters.name: Minato Sakai
characters.description: A Black Knight officer dispatched to Neo-Britannian-occupied Hokkaido to assist anti-NB resistance fighters alongside Nina. Locked Out of the Loop: According to Shizuka, she doesn't know that Rozé is Sakuya. Sazanami didn't want to tell her because she was too honest and carrying a secret like that would be too much.

characters.name: In General
characters.description: Airstrip One: Britannia has a policy of renaming captured nations as numbered Areas, with Japan being Area 11 and the Middle Eastern Federation being Area 18, for example. By extension, all natives of these regions are referred to by theFantastic Slurof their numbers (e.g. Elevens for Japanese). Bright Is Not Good: Favour bright, flashy hues for their clothing and decorations and areincrediblyself-righteousSocial Darwiniststhat view it as their right to trample and dehumanize other nations. Culture Chop Suey: Though the series doesn't really dive into the finer aspects of Britannian culture, it's depicted as ostensibly based on the worst aspects of the British Empire, but also with elements Arthurian, Celtic, and Germanic culture (while the former two had some influence on each other, the latter's influence was at best moderate). It's extremely violent court politicking (where siblings had to kill each other sometimes just to survive), also brings to mind the Ottoman Empire, when it was one of the most dangerous places to be royalty.Its role in the story as an aggressive, hyper-expansionist, autocratic state with harsh racialist beliefs, also brings to mind the Axis powers from World War 2.Britannia's state in the aftermath, as a state that while still powerful and advanced, becomes secondary to a larger, democratic faction, while having its entire culture effectively rebooted also resembles the fate of both Germany and Japan. characters.name: Kensei Kuroto
characters.description: The leader of the Seven Shining Stars. Being a veteran soldier who has overcome many battles, he is well-respected by his fellow members. Alliterative Name:KenseiKuroto. Badass in Distress: Initially imprisoned by Neo-Britannia, he retakes command of the Seven Shining Stars after Rozé frees him and leads them to escape Arnold and his subordinates. The Comically Serious: In the final episode he tries to make small talk with his daughterHarukaby asking her if she has a 'Fella' in his typical stoic voice, and she points out no one uses that word anymore. Old Retainer: After Japan's liberation, he became a bodyguard to Jugo Sumeragi and his family. When Rozé rescues him and reveals that he's Sakuya, Kuroto becomes more determined to fight for his people and aid his liege. Even when they are alone together, Kuroto still sees Sakuya as his superior.

characters.name: Isao Monobe
characters.description: The member of the Seven Shining Stars with the second longest history of activity after Kuroto. Big Damn Heroes: In episode 8,he saves Ash who is about to be shot in the head by Arnold. Frontline General: Despite being Kuroto's second-in-command, he personally pilots a Knightmare alongside his fellow soldiers to rescue their general. Get a Hold of Yourself, Man!:He grabs Rozé on the collar and calls him out for being defeatist after being captured by Neo-Britannia which leads to the Seven Shining Stars losing their main base and the majority of the resistance sacrificing their lives to help them escape. While he doesn't blame Rozé for what had happened, he reminds him not to insult those who died for them. Heroic Sacrifice:In Episode 11, he lures the L.O.K.I.s that are guarding the power source to him and detonates the Sakuradite bombs to destroy them so that Haruka can turn on the power and help Rozé hack into the control system and shut down the Stumpe barrier, surrounding Hokkaido.

characters.name: Haruka Rutaka
characters.description: The ace pilot of the Seven Shining Stars. Ace Pilot: She excels at piloting a Knightmare Frame. It's why Rozé gives her the newestAce CustomKeisetsu. Close-Range Combatant: Rozé notices Haruka's strong suit is close-quarters combat, and orders the Keisetsu be modified to fit her fighting style. Contrasting Sequel Main Character: She has many similarities with Kallen Kozuki, being theAce Pilotof her respective resistance group, but she's not anInstant Expertand is nowhere near asHot-Bloodedas Kallen. Good Old Fisticuffs: When not using the Keisetsu's spear Haruka will bring out energy fisticuffs to fight.

characters.name: Tomo'omi Oda
characters.description: A playful guy who cares for his friends. Hot-Blooded: He's easily the most hot-headed member of the Seven Shining Stars, although he's not unreasonable. Red/Green Contrast: He wears a red jacket, which serves to highlight his more aggressive temperament in comparison to Shouta's green jacket. Red Oni, Blue Oni: He's theHot-BloodedRed Oni to Shouta's calmer Blue Oni. This Is Gonna Suck: His reaction when Kuroto directs him to stallNarah Vaughan.

characters.name: Shouta Munemori
characters.description: A guy who fights on the front lines alongside Oda. Eyes Always Shut: He's normally seen with his eyes closed. Red/Green Contrast: He wears a green jacket to highlight his milder temperament in contrast to Tomo'omi's red jacket. Red Oni, Blue Oni: He's the calmer Blue Oni to Tomo'omi'sHot-BloodedRed Oni. Vitriolic Best Buds: He likes to playfully tease Oda, but it's clear they're good friends.

characters.name: Youko Araki
characters.description: A member who serves as the operator during battle. Eating the Eye Candy: She very much enjoys the sight of Ash shirtless, and how he becomes bashful when he notices the girls because "the submissive thing" does it for her. Mission Control: She helps coordinate battles alongside Kuroto. Ms. Fanservice: She has very large breasts and wears revealing clothing that shows off her cleavage, midriff, and thighs. Town Girls: The Femme to Yuuri's Butch and Haruka's neither.

characters.name: Yuuri Sano
characters.description: The mechanic of the Seven Shining Stars. Big Ol' Eyebrows: Her eyebrows are thicker compared to other characters. Girlish Pigtails: She ties her hair into low pigtails that make her look girlish. Idiot Hair: She has anahogestanding on her head, showing her upbeat personality. Tank-Top Tomboy: She wears a tank top under her jumpsuit and she's the least feminine of the three females of the Seven Shining Stars.

characters.name: Shirley Fenette
characters.description: One of Lelouch's classmates in Ashford Academy. Kind and sweet to everyone, and is hopelessly and madly in love with Lelouch. Her fate becomes intertwined with his once she discovers that the laid back Lelouch is actually the masked terrorist Zero, but still believes that passion and love will win the day, even in war. Adaptation Expansion:Thanks to Jeremiah advising Shirley to stay away from trouble in the second film, she and Rolo never met and would later play a key role in C.C.'s attempt tobring back LelouchinRe;surrection. Adaptational Angst Downgrade: In theCompilation Movie,with both herandher father beingSpared by the Adaptation. The worst that happens to her is seeing her beloved Lulu getting killed. Adaptational Badass: Becomes this in theLost StoriesRoute Entanglement"Sky of Lamentation", as a result of undergoingUnwilling Roboticisationin place of Jeremiah. Also a case ofAdaptational Villainyas said experimentation lead to her becoming aPsychopathic Manchildthat really wants to love/kill Lelouch. Affectionate Nickname:Calls Lelouch by the name 'Lulu', though she stopsafter he erases her memories of him.Starts again inR2.Calls Nunally 'Nunna', until R2, when her memories are altered.Her regaining them and referring to her as such in front of Rolo has devastating consequences.

characters.name: Milly Ashford
characters.description: The student council president at Ashford Academy, granddaughter of the school's owner and former nobility, she loves playfully teasing her friends just as much as she supports them. She's also one of the only characters who initially knows of Lelouch's former status as royalty, as well as Kallen's Japanese nationality. By R2, she graduates from Ashford Academy and becomes a news reporter. Absurdly Powerful Student Council: She is its president and can hijack and entire school day for a Cupid Day festival game. Ambiguously Bi: Shereallylikes teasing and groping Shirley. At the same time, she's confirmed to also have a crush onLelouch. Arranged Marriage: To EarlLloyd Asplund.Later, she calls it off. The Beautiful Elite: AHead-Turning Beautyand part of the Britannia elite in Japan.

characters.name: Nina Einstein
characters.description: A shy student of Ashford Academy who is openly discriminatory towards the Japanese due to her past traumas. She's not all there mentally, and becomes obsessed with Princess Euphemia. In R2, she gets recruited by Schneizel and becomes one of the empire's top scientists. Accidental Hero: TheLost StoriesRoute Entanglement "Farewell Dawn"has her unknowingly thwart Charles' Ragnarök Connection by nuking Pendragon with a F.L.E.I.J.A. right when he was about to initiate it, and she only did that because Marianne made the mistake of setting her off by casually dismissing Euphemia. Adaptational Nice Gal: The compilation movies downplay herStalker with a Crushtendencies towards Princess Euphemia, and have hercome to her senses much quicker, not eventryingto detonate the prototype F.L.E.I.J.A. Ambiguously Bi: While she openly likes women as her feelings for Euphemia attest, she doesn't express any sexual attraction towards men in the original anime. The Visual NovelCode Geass: Lost Colors, which is confirmed canon viaCode Geass: Oz the Reflection, has her as one of the many romantic routes Rai can take. Since Rai is theonlymale she's expressed attraction to though, it's unclear if she's fully bisexual, or if she's gay andRai is the exception. Ambiguously Jewish: Her curly hair, her nerdy personality, and most of all her famous last name.

characters.name: Rivalz Cardemonde
characters.description: One of Lelouch's friends, who usually just drives him around to gambling matches before the events of the series. He's the most ordinary of the student council, with at least half of them being involved in war in some manner. Badass Biker: Proves surprisingly capable at evasive maneuvers with his motorbike, managing to evadeseveral Black Knightswhile also carrying Nina. Best Friend: To Lelouch, although it's almost anInformed Attributesince the series doesn't put much focus on their friendship. Birds of a Feather: Both he and Lelouch have issues with their respective fathers. This is hinted to be the reason why Lelouch stopped to help Rivalz out of a tight spot and ended up becoming friends. Bromantic Foil: To Lelouch, who's cool and detached while Rivalz is awkward and overly emotional.

characters.name: Arthur
characters.description: InR2, she was adopted by Suzaku for a while before she returns to Ashford. Cat Stereotype: Fits the "stubborn and friendly" version of the black cat stereotype. From Stray to Pet: Was originally a stray before being found by Euphemia, then wandering into Ashford Academy. Gender-Blender Name: In the original Japanese, she's female, but has a masculine name. Gender Flip: Is female in the original Japanese, but male in the English dub.

characters.name: Sayoko Shinozaki
characters.description: AJapanese maid— twenty-four years old in season one and twenty-five in season two — Sayoko is employed by the Ashford family, assigned as the caretaker for Lelouch and Nunnally when they get into Ashford Academy. Quirky, devoted, sweet and highly protective of the Lamperouge siblings, she's the closest to a mother figure that they have after Marianne's horrible death. Ambiguously Bi: She's devoted to Lelouch and Jeremiah, but she also has no trouble shacking up with over a hundred girls while posing as Lelouch. Additionally, in R2 Episode 12 she thinks to herself that she would "like Miss Milly to catch [her]." Action Girl: A highly skilledNinja Maid. Alliterative Name:SayokoShinozaki. Ascended Meme: The show staff joked during the first season that she was secretly the strongest character in the series. Come season two, they decided to make it canon by having her reveal herself as aNinja Maidwho can perform astonishing acts of athleticism and casually keeps throwing dartshidden on her person.

characters.name: Lloyd Asplund
characters.description: An earl of the Britannian Empire and the series' mainMad Scientist. Anti-Villain: He works for theBig Badand enjoys making deadlier weapons but he himself is indifferent to the war or morality itself for that matter. Aristocrats Are Evil: He likes to play the part of the remorseless lord scientist, but it's really an act. Arranged Marriage:Plans one to Milly so he can gain access to some antique Knightmare frames. Later, she calls it off. Blue Blood: He's actually a Britannian Earl.

characters.name: Cécile Croomy
characters.description: Cécile Croomy is Lloyd's subordinate in Camelot and one of the Lancelot's developers. She is a capable scientist in her own right, having designed the Energy Wing system used on the Guren Seiten and the Lancelot Albion. Cécile is a kind-hearted woman and a good friend to Suzaku, often helping him with homework. She also acts as Lloyd's conscience, scolding him for his unintentionally rude remarks or for treating Suzaku as a "part" for his Mechas. A recurring joke is that Cécile is a bad cook, though no one has the heart to tell her. It seems to be implied in one of thepicture dramasthat Cécile is in love with Suzaku and that a former love of hers died in battle. Ace Custom: During the First Battle of Tokyo at the end of the first season, Cécile makes use of a Customized Sutherland outfitted with aBlaze Luminousand Float System to saveSuzaku. Alliterative Name:CécileCroomy. Badass Bookworm: Cécile is a brilliant scientist on par with Lloyd, and during the First Battle of Tokyo, she shows herself to be a fairly capable Knightmare pilot when she saves Suzaku and manages to hold off the Black Knights holding Ashford Academy pretty much single-handedly. Beleaguered Assistant: She often has to contend to problems caused by Lloyd'sDitzy Geniusways.

characters.name: Alicia Lohmeyer
characters.description: Introduced in the second season. An aide to Nunnally seen after she was re-inducted into the royal family and swore in as Viceroy of Area 11. Though her true duty was to make sure Nunnally followed the Emperor's orders. Asshole Victim:She ends up getting caught in the F.L.E.I.J.A. explosion triggered by Suzaku's "Live" command several weeks after she says Elevens deserve to burn in Hell. Fantastic Racism: Makes it no secret she hates Elevens as her every advisement is to assert Britannians control over them. She nearly starts a second massacre of it during Zero's exile by almost firing into the crowd after they don Zero masks. Suzaku manages to prevent her in time. Four Eyes, Zero Soul: A glasses wearer and not at all a nice person. Hate Sink: While less vile than Luciano or the High Eunuchs, she's still given no sympathetic traits and just embodies the racist, discriminatory values of Britannia. She also attempts to kill a million Elevens while stating they deserve to "burn in hell" in the English dub and tries to kill Kallen just to spite Nunnally. It speaks volumes that she's one of the few charactersNunnallygets mad at.

characters.name: Jeremiah Gottwald
characters.description: A high ranking soldier in the Britannian army who was initially not supposed to be in the series past his first few appearances, he winds up becoming a more important figure in season two. Ace Pilot: He's an elite Knightmare pilot, being able to hold offfourenemy pilots long enough for Suzaku to bail him out, and beats the hell out of Lelouch's Gawain with Lelouch being unable to land a single hit, until C.C. takes him down with a kamikaze attack. Then gets even more competent after hejoins Lelouch: He evades several strikes from V.V. despite being in a weaker Sutherland, when stronger Knightmares present aren't able to do so. He fights evenly with Suzaku and comes close tokillinghim (with help from Guilford) without taking any damage himself. And he wins against Anya by self-destructing his unit to blow open the Mordred, then jumps on top of it and forces her to surrender at swordpoint. Adaptational Intelligence: In the secondCompilation Movie,his accidental restoration of Shirley's memories doesn't go unnoticed, having recognized her from some files, so the moment she processes rememberingwhat little she has to this time, he's already there to warn her not to further involved for her own safety,which ultimately works. Anti-Magic:As aCyborg, he gets armed with the Geass canceller and is able to negate the effects of other Geass, which includes restoring memories suppressed or modified through Geass abilities. Appropriated Appellation: Absolutely hated being referred to as "Orange Boy" by his peers and enemies in the first season, as it's reflected from the scorn and distrust started by Lelouch when his plan to frame Suzaku failed.ComeR2, he begins to wholeheartedly accept "Orange" as his codename, especially once he learns that Zero has been Lelouch the entire time and swears loyalty to him from there on.

characters.name: Villetta Nu / "Chigusa"
characters.description: One of Jeremiah Gottwald's most devoted subordinates, Villetta Nu is a twenty-six-year-old Knightmare Frame pilot. Like Jeremiah, she belongs to a segregationist group called the Pure Bloods, Britannians who believe that Elevens and other Numbers (i.e., people of Japanese or other non-Britannian descent) should be forbidden from serving in the Britannian military or otherwise contaminating Britannian society. Although Villetta does not hail from the aristocracy, she hopes to sufficiently distinguish herself in the service of her country as to earn her family hereditary knighthood. After Zero uses his mind control geass to ruin Jeremiah's career and very nearly Villetta's as well, she does some quick thinking and realizes that he must have connections at Ashford Academy. She hopes that by capturing Zero, she can bring herself glory and simultaneously redeem Jeremiah. But fate, or luck, has some surprises for her. Adaptational Karma: Ends R2 as aKarma Houdiniwhile a ''Genesic Re-CODE' scenariohas her and Ohgi caught by Shirley, Sayoko and Rolo. Bonus points for the karma of being caught by the young girl she previously manipulated to uncover Zero's identity. Adaptational Nice Girl: TheCompilation Movieexcises her manipulating Shirley and indirectly setting off the girlsTrauma Conga Line. Ambiguously Brown: Villetta's exact origins are never revealed, though her skin is darker than most of the characters, especially the Britannians. Her last name suggests a Thai or Spanish history. Many fans think she's of Amerindian descent. Stage 4.33 confirms that Villetta isn't of Britannian descent.

characters.name: Kewell Soresi
characters.description: Another member of the Purists, and by far the most blatantly racist. Fantastic Racism: Even compared to Villetta and Jeremiah, he stands out. Flat Character: All we really know about him is that he is a Purist and a racist. Karmic Death: For all his racist mindset, he ends up getting killed off by Kallen, an Eleven (granted half-Britannian, but still). Mauve Shirt: Appears in a few episodes, gets some minor characterization, and is then unceremoniously killed off by Kallen.

characters.name: Gilbert G.P. Guilford
characters.description: Personal knight of Second Princess Cornelia li Britannia with unwavering devotion to his princess and piloting skill matching Kyoshiro Tohdoh. Ace Custom: Adownplayedexample. None of Guilford's Knightmares are exactly unique to him, but he still tends to use higher-performing variations of existing Knightmares. His original Knightmare was a Gloucester, outfitted with a cape to denote his being Cornelia's knight, and later given Maser Vibration Swords. His second Knightmare was the first shown Vincent Commander Model, an upgraded version of the Vincent that Rolo had used, Guilford having one being notable since, before Lelouch took the throne, the only other ones were used by Luciano Bradley's Valkyrie Squadron, and the Royal Guard led by Monica Krushevsky. His last Knightmare would be the Quinn Roses Type-B, a modified version of the Quinn Roses Type-Z that Cornelia would pilotas a member of the Black Knights. Big Brother Mentor: Hetriesto be this for Suzaku during the events of R2, attempting to establish a point of commonality in how they were both Knights of Honor to the li Britannia sisters, and saying Suzaku can come to him should he ever need to. Unfortunately for him, Suzaku is too wrapped up in his own issues to ever really rely on him.Guilford:Your rank may have changed, but you did start out as Princess Euphemia's Knight. As the Knight of Princess Cornelia, I'd like you to see me as a source of advice that you'll ask for when needed. Blind People Wear Sunglasses:Downplayed. When he reunites with Cornelia on Horai Island, he's shown wearing sunglasses and requires using a crutch to get around. While this would suggest that he was rendered blind as a side effect of the FLEIJA, he later shows no issue moving around without the crutch andcansee, suggesting the glasses are a result of the FLEIJAdamaginghis vision. He is subsequently shown wearing them at all times, including when with Cornelia's resistance group intending to free those slated for execution befo

characters.name: Andreas Darlton
characters.description: A general in the Britannian Army and one of Cornelia's most loyal followers. Affably Evil: One of the nicer Britannians, especially since he adopts war orphans who might have been from countries he has helped conquer. He also considered adopting Suzaku to help smooth out his life as an Honorary Britannian. Alas, Poor Villain:His very last thoughts are about his guilt in attacking Cornelia, and wondering why he did that in the first place (a Geass cast on him by Lelouch), before being promptly murdered. Arrogant Kung-Fu Guy: Challenges Suzaku to a duel to prove his superiority inNightmare of Nunnally, which leads to Suzaku evading all his attacks, as he considers him not worth fighting. I Can Still Fight!: Despite having been shot byEuphemia, when he tried to stop the SAZ massacre, he continues to the battle for Tokyo.It helps that he's been Geassed.

characters.name: The Glaston Knights
characters.description: The adoptive sons of Andreas Darlton, the Glaston Knights are one of Britannia's elite fighting forces. Ace Custom: They use customized Gloucesters with blue shoulders. Alphabetical Theme Naming: Their first names areAlfred,Bart,Claudio,David, andEgar. Ascended Extra: Owing to being theSole Survivorof the group in canon, Claudio has an expanded role in ''Code Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion Lost Stories, where he becomes one of Disel's main allies during their time in the Britannian military. Dwindling Party: The group is gradually wiped out over the course of R2, with Alfred being killed by Kallen during Zero's return while Bart is crushed by a falling G1 base in the same instance, followed by David and Edgar being slain during the Second Black Rebellion - David is cutdown by Chiba, with Edgar's outrage at his brother's death givng Tohdoh the opening to kill him.

characters.name: Kanon Maldini
characters.description: Schneizel's caretaker and right-hand man — publicandprivate. Blue Blood: An Earl in the Britannian Empire. A Day in the Limelight:Gets more attention in theLancelot & Gurenspin-off, which puts more focus on what exactly he was doing during the series and what his role is for Schneizel.Code Geass: Oz the Reflectionfleshes him out, revealing he's old friends with the Knight of Nine, Nonette, and his position serving under Schneizel is more accurately as hisMorality Chain. Gets more attention in theLancelot & Gurenspin-off, which puts more focus on what exactly he was doing during the series and what his role is for Schneizel. Code Geass: Oz the Reflectionfleshes him out, revealing he's old friends with the Knight of Nine, Nonette, and his position serving under Schneizel is more accurately as hisMorality Chain.

characters.name: Royal Guard Commander
characters.description: A ruthless Britannian general, he is introduced as Suzaku Kururugi's commanding officer. He is placed in charge with recapturing C.C., and ends up in a confrontation with Lelouch which inadvertently kickstarts the entire plot. Asshole Victim: Lelouch's first victim couldn't have been more deserving. Death by Irony: His sick devotion to Britannia pretty much led to him and his soldiers killing themselves under the orders of (former) royalty."Happily, your highness!" Disproportionate Retribution: He guns Suzaku down for questioning his orders to execute Lelouch. General Ripper: Par for the course. See also:Sociopathic Soldier.

characters.name: Alice
characters.description: A character unique toCode Geass: Nightmare of Nunnally, in which she's Nunnally's best friend. She is also a member of the Britannian Special Honorary Foreign Legion, a group of pilots with Geass skills who came from the numbered areas. Her mission is both to observe Nunnally and to capture the mysterious Mark Nemo — unaware that Nunnally is its pilot. Badass Cape: She gets one with her leotard suit once she accepts Nemo's contract. Badass Long Coat: Used a visual cue forAlice's transformation into Nunnally's knight.In the previous scene she wore her Irregular uniform in a cell and was an emotional wreck. In the next scene she's tall, proud, and wearing the long coat. Battle Butler: Becomes Nunnally's. Whether piloting a Knightmare or in hand-to-hand combat, this girl can kick some serious ass. Berserk Button: She haszerotolerance for bullying, which is what cause her to meet and befriend Nunnally in the first place.Trying to harm Nunnally also becomes a good way to, at best, have skirt stolen, or at worse, get an ass kicking from Alice.

characters.name: Commodore Matthew Perry
characters.description: The main antagonist ofCode Geass: Tales of an Alternate Shogunate, he forces Japan open on unequal terms using his Geass and oppresses the Japanese. Annoying Laugh: Lelouch compares it to the buzzing of a mosquito. Compelling Voice: He has Lelouch's Geass in this continuity. It's All About Me:He's doing what he's doing purely for his own gain, and not for Britannia, thus leading Euphemia and Suzaku to fight against him. Kick the Dog:Firing on his own men.

characters.name: Knight of I — Sir Bismarck Waldstein
characters.description: The Knight of One, recognized as the strongest soldier in the Britannian Empire. Anti-Villain:The Noble variant. He's shown to be a decent, honorable man who just so happens to beThe Dragon. Avenging the Villain:He leads the Knights of the Round to remove Lelouch from power after Charles is killed. This leads to his death at the hands of Suzaku. BFS: His Knightmare's sword, Excalibur, is so hilariously huge that its sheath has its own rocket booster. He later uses one on his person as well. Charles Atlas Superpower: Even the blatantly superhuman Suzaku doesn't hold a candle to him in a hand-to-hand fight, to the point where his "Live" Geass kicks in and almost forces him to book it.

characters.name: Knight of III — Gino Weinberg
characters.description: The Knight of Three, and one of the youngest Knights of the Round besides Suzaku and Anya. Ace Pilot: Gino shows shades of being a bushwhacker, as while being a frontline fighter (a steamroller) he is also a sneakyCombat Pragmatistwho prefers to ambush and/or backstab his opponents.His Tristan also has its fighter alt modewhich allows him to easily escaped and/or evade his enemies. Affably Evil: Despite being a loyal soldier of an expansionist empire, Gino is one of the friendliest and most outgoing Britannians in the series. He has no real malice towards his enemies, and at several points stops fellow Britannians from committing war crimes. Amazon Chaser: Is smitten withKallenin large part because she's the best all-around female fighter (i.e. both as a mecha pilot and martial artist) in the series. Angst? What Angst?: Gino ran away from home at 16 to join the military because he could not accept the deep prejudice that ran in his family. He is shown to be one of the most optimistic and idealistic characters, however.

characters.name: Knight of IV — Dorothea Ernst
characters.description: The Knight of Four. Not much else is known about her, since she is killed in her only scene. Ambiguously Brown: It isn't really clear what ethnicity she is, but she has dark brown skin coupled with green eyes. Notably, her Palomides is named after the most prominent non-European Knight of the Round Table. Bit Character: We don't really get to knowanythingabout her before she dies. Additionally, unlike Monica and Nonette, she's never given anyAdaptation Expansionin the canon spin-offs aside from the specifics of her Knightmare, called the Palomides.According toWord of Godin a livestream for the Lost Stories smartphone game, her singleThis Cannot Be!line was originally assigned to Nonette, whose voice actress wasn’t available. The scene was redrawn with Dorothea, portrayed by Inoue Kikuko who was on scene. According toWord of Godin a livestream for the Lost Stories smartphone game, her singleThis Cannot Be!line was originally assigned to Nonette, whose voice actress wasn’t available. The scene was redrawn with Dorothea, portrayed by Inoue Kikuko who was on scene. Black Dude Dies First: Somewhat. She is the oneAmbiguously Brownmember of the Knights of the Round, and is the first to be killed by Suzaku in the Lancelot Albion when he massacres them.Story-wise, however, she subverts this as she is thesecondof her group to die; Luciano Bradley is killed in the Second Battle of Tokyo by Kallen, some time before the Knights of the Round go after Lelouch.

characters.name: Knight of VI — Anya Alstreim
characters.description: Ayoungnoblewoman from Britannia, Anya Alstreim — the Knight of Six — is a fifteen-year-old girl withprodigious piloting skills, a staggering lack of common sense when off the battlefield, and quite a bad case ofemotionlessnessin regards to almost anything aside from fighting. In addition, Anya suffers from memory problems, so she keeps a blog wherein she stores thousands of photos, in an attempt not to forget anything anymore. Ace Pilot: She's a very skilled pilot, and a sniper at that, showering her opponents with overwhelming firepower from a distance with her Mordred. In the novels, she also served as Nunnally's Knight at one point, so she's likely a skilled fighter like most of the other Knights of the Round. Adaptational Villainy:Because V.V. doesn't exist in theNightmare of Nunnallyseries, she's the one who ends up assassinating Marianne instead as a plantedchild assassinby the Anti-Marianne faction. This is in contrast to her main series incarnation, who was pretty much just an ordinary noble girl prior to Marianne possessing her with her Geass. Age-Inappropriate Dress: Her Knightmare uniform which is basically a onesie. Alliterative Name:AnyaAlstreim.

characters.name: Knight of IX — Nonette Enneagram
characters.description: The Knight of Nine. She only appears a few times in theCode Geassanime, and mainly appears in theLost Colorsvideo game and theSpin-OffmangaCode Geass: Oz the Reflection. She attended the same military academy as Cornelia as her senior. HerGenki Girldemeanor disguises someone that even Cornelia is afraid of. Ace Custom: Nonette pilots a custom version of the Lancelot Club. The MVS Lance Blades have been replaced by Sword Blade versions, the arms are equipped with Luminous Cone generators, and it wields a Jousting Lance, leaving it more suited as a Close Combat type KMF. Beware the Nice Ones: Despite her cheery demeanor, Nonette is one of the few people Cornelia actually fears. The Cameo: At the beginning ofThe Awakening Pathrecap movie, she is one of the Britannian nobles attending Lelouch and Nunnally's departure for Japan, assumedly due to her relationship with Cornelia. Canon Immigrant: Her KMF, the Lancelot Club, debuted in theLost Colorsgame of dubious canonicity, before being canonized during her time inOz the Reflection.

characters.name: Knight of X — Luciano Bradley
characters.description: The Knight of Ten and the "Vampire of Britannia", who participates in battle so that he can deprive people of what he believes they value most—their lives. Arson, Murder, and Jaywalking: When he's first introduced he viciously insults Suzaku's heritage, mentions wanting to rape and torture Kallen and... says Gino is a bad pilot due to him being anUpper-Class Twit. Attempted Rape: When talking to an imprisoned Kallen he brings up how he is free to do whatever he wants to her making the implications obvious, fortunately he is prevented from doing so when Gino stops him. Bad Boss: To say that he treats his subordinates no better than his enemies would be an understatement. When one of the Britannian's ships was shot he decides to use it as a weapon to crash into the enemy base, leading to all the crew being killed as a result. During the Battle of Tokyo he would even use one of his own soldiers as a shield to buy himself time. Blood Knight: Of the "loving to kill" kind. He loves war because it gives him the opportunity to rob people of their lives against their will.

characters.name: Knight of XII — Monica Krushevsky
characters.description: The Knight of Twelve and leader of the Emperor's Royal Guard, Monica joined the Britannian Military at a young age after her father was killed by terrorists, and proved aChild Prodigy, becoming one of Britannia's Knights of the Round. Ace Custom: Though we don't get to see it in the anime,Oz Of The Reflectionshows us hers: the Florence, a modifiedAlexandermade for her. Animal Mecha: Her Knightmare Frame, Florence, is based off aSlaying Mantis. Beware the Nice Ones: While she is aNice Girl, she is also the leader of the Emperor's Royal Guard, and a certifiedBlood Knight. Child Prodigy: One of the youngest members of the Knights alongside Gino and Anya, being only 19 years old at R2, presumably she became a member at 17 before her appearance in the Side Orpheus novel.

characters.name: Knight of II — Beatrice Franks
characters.description: The Friend Nobody Likes: Gino and Anya dislike dealing with her due to her cold personality. Ice Queen: She is described as emotionless and coldhearted, unlike Anya who has difficulty expressing emotion it’s implied that she has none.

characters.name: Knight of VIII — Victoria
characters.description: Cool Sword: It turns into a whip sword and is powerful enough to defeat a Knightmare. Ms. Fanservice: She gets aBathtub/Furo Scenein chapter 28.

characters.name: Knight of XIII — Barbaros
characters.description: 13 Is Unlucky: He was once the Knight of Thirteen and a depraved sadist. Hate Sink: In addition to having executed Alto Weinberg’s entire family and sell female captives into slavery, he planned to hack off Claire’s limbs and gouge out her eyes to make her into a submissive puppet for Lorenzo il Soresi's takeover of the Empire.

characters.name: Oldrin Zevon
characters.description: The main ace of the Glinda Knights and the childhood friend of Princess Marrybell. She is the heir of the Zevon noble family, who succeeds via the female line. However, she left her family and entered the military when the Zevon family was on the verge of being taking over by her uncle Oiaguro. Ace Custom: The Lancelot Grail, a variant of the Lancelot. It is later upgraded into the Lancelot High-Grail. During her time with the "Star of Madrid", she pilots the Amanecer, a Knightmare based off the Akatsuki but on par with the Zangetsu. Ambiguously Gay: And if her bed scenes with Marrybell are anything to go by, maybenotso ambiguous, although it has never been confirmed that she is lesbian or even bisexual. Blade Spam: All of the Knightmares she pilots use alotof swords. Her Lancelot Grail alone mounts12. Break the Believer: After a confrontation with Wizard at her mother's grave, she begins to question if she really is doing the right thing as part of the Glinda Knights, as the terrorists they hunt are part of "the people" the group swore to protect. As Marrybell becomes more and more ruthless in stopping terrorists though, Oldrin defects to the Star of Madrid resistance group, realizing she can't protect the people as part of the Glinda Knights anymore.

characters.name: Leonhardt Steiner
characters.description: Leonhardt Steiner is a knight belonging to the Glinda Knights. He is also member of the engineering Steiner noble family that runs the conglomerate Steiner Konzern, in service to the Weinbergs. Although he can be courageous on the battlefield, he's a shy person in real life and is often teased by both Oldrin and Sokia. He represents the Cowardly Lion. Meaningful Name:Leonhardt = Leon hart = Lion Heart Super Prototype: Bradford, the prototype of the Tristan. Wave-Motion Gun: The Bradford's Hadron Spear. However its an incomplete weapon and tends to explode after usage, and can only be used once before the machine needs to be repaired.

characters.name: Marika Soresi
characters.description: Kewell's younger sister and an on-again off-again member of the Glinda Knights. She is made a member of the Knight of Ten's "Valkyrie Squadron", nearly costing her life against Kallen during the Battle of Tokyo. She was saved thanks to her fiance Leonhardt pulling aBig Damn Heroesmoment, the two proceeding to wed after Emperor Lelouch's death. She would then join under Oldrin in the new Glinda Knights alongside her husband. Amazon Brigade: She spent some time in the all-girl Valkyrie Squadron. They didn't amount to much though, with Kallen slaughtering everyone in the squad but her. Ascended Extra: Marika debuted in the anime, having about two scenes in the second season only to seemingly die. She has more focus in theSpin-Offmanga,Code Geass: Oz the Reflection, detailing her history and the nature of her survival. Custom Uniform: While a part of the Valkrie Squadron, she's forced to wear a rather ridiculous one. Earn Your Happy Ending: After having to suffer the loss of her brother, forced to serve under the psychotic Knight of Ten Luciano, and nearly die at the hands of Kallen, she is saved by her fiancee, gets to have a proper wedding with him, and join the reformed Glinda Knights under her friend Oldrin.

characters.name: Tink Rockheart
characters.description: Tink Rockheart is a knight belonging to the Glinda Knights. He excels with positional defense ability and cherishes his comrades, but because of his insensitivity, his kindness can be kind of meddlesome. He was originally a test pilot in the Royal KMF Technical Research Institute, but because of an accident during his time there, over 30% of his body has been replaced by cybernetics. He represents the Tin Woodman. The Big Guy: Is the tallest and most physically imposing of the Glinda Knights, and wields a Knightmare Frame that hashas the armour and firepower expected of the Mordreds prototype. Meaningful Name:Tink Rockheart = Tin (with a) Heart of Rock Super Prototype: Zetland, the prototype of the Mordred.

characters.name: Sokia Scerpa
characters.description: Sokia Scerpa is a knight belonging to the Glinda Knights. She possesses high tactical and information analysis abilities, but tends to say whatever she thinks without thinking about it first. Her atmosphere completely changes between her everyday life and when in battle. She frequently sexually harasses Oldrin, Toto and Marrybell. She doesn't show interest in men that are lacking. She represents the Scarecrow. Ace Custom: Sutherland Eye, a command unit specialized for search and destroy. Alliterative Name:SokiaScerpa Attack Drone: Her Sheffield Eye is equipped with ACO Harkens, which are semi-autonomous with high behavior prediction.

characters.name: Toto Thompson
characters.description: Toto Thompson is a gentle girl who served the Zevon family as a maid and now serves within the Glinda Knights as an operator of the floating airship "Granberry". She recognizes Oldrin as the proper successor of the Zevon family and has the strength of heart to the extent that she entered the military along with Oldrin. She serves Oldrin as both a maid and a friend. She represents Toto, the dog. Alliterative Name:TotoThompson. Secret-Keeper: She's presumably the only one who knows that her mistress and Marrybell are lovers, which she keeps even from them.[2]

characters.name: Oiagros Zevon
characters.description: The current head of the Zevon family, Oiagros assassinated his older sister and took control of the traditionally matriarchal family. As head of Pluton, he is privy to most, if not all, of the Britannian Imperial Family's secrets, and accepts orders from both the Emperor and V.V. He represents the Wizard of Oz. For more information about him as Wizard, clickhere.

characters.name: Emperor Charles zi Britannia
characters.description: Ruler of the Britannian Empire and father to Lelouch and his siblings, Charles is introduced as aSocial Darwinistwho thinks that war is the best way to create social progress. It's eventually revealed that his true agenda is to use the Ragnarok Connection to create "a world without lies", a desire brought about by being raised in a royal family whose members killed and deceived each other for power.Ironically, Charles' actions only perpetuate the cycle of violence and result in Lelouch's campaign to destroy the empire his family built. 0% Approval Rating: The peoples of the nations Britannia has conquered despise him for obvious reasons, and his largely hands-off approach to ruling causes most other members of the Britannian military and government to gravitate to his children, particularly Schneizel, as opposed to him. Above Good and Evil: He considers good and evil to be just sides of a coin, meaningless human diversions that distract from his scheme to create a perfect world of blended thought and truth. Abusive Parents: He pushes his kids to take dangerous jobs... and subtly encourages them to war with and kill one another to secure their position in the line of succession. Lelouch gets the worst of it, getting disowned, screamed at, and used as a political hostage when he gets angry at Charles for not giving a damn about the assassination of Lelouch's mother or the crippling of his little sister in the same incident.Nunnally's blindness was not the result of traumatic stress, but because Charles inflicted it upon her with his Geass, ostensibly to protect her by making people think she wasn't a threat. While he doesfavor Lelouch and Nunnally over his other childrenand kept his work on the Ragnarok Connection a secret until they were both ready to hear it, it still did not change how he treated them beforehand - in fact, hearing of the Ragnarok Connection onlyenragesLelouch even further, since it was obvious that his own parents cared more about fulfilling their

characters.name: Empress Marianne vi Britannia
characters.description: The Late Empress-Consort of Britannia, wife of Charles zi Britannia, and mother to Nunnally and Lelouch, she was first introduced as aMissing Momkilled by unknown assassins. It was due to this that her kids got kicked out of the Britannian Empire, which in turn caused Lelouch to hate Britannia and begin his rebellion. To many people, she was known as Marianne the Flash, a powerfulAction Momand a nice person overall that everyone adores (providing they are not snobbish nobles). Absurdly Youthful Mother: Going by their birthdates, Marianne had only just turned 19 when Lelouch was born. Abusive Parents:While not as obvious as Charles, Marianne is guilty of this trope herself. Even though she survived V.V.'s assassination attempt by possessing Anya, she never once checked up on Lelouch and Nunnally while they were in exile, putting the Ragnarok Connection first and foremost above the status of her own children. And when Lelouch finds her alive and well, Marianne attempts to emotionally manipulate him with the prospect of seeing his dead friends and loved ones, expecting him to side with his parents immediately once he saw their good intentions. But Lelouchturns the tables on her, stating that no matter how well-intentioned she was,she only cared about herself, her husband, and the Ragnarok Connection. What confirmed it was Marianne's displeased reaction to Lelouch's attempt to GeassGodinto opposing the Ragnarok Connection, running to her son in an attempt to discipline him while calling him a "foolish, ungrateful child" before being stopped by Suzaku. Ace Pilot: Being a former Knight and one of the first Knightmare Frame pilots qualifies. Affably Evil:She may have a gentle demeanor, but that doesn't stop her from wanting to forcibly merge all of humanity.

characters.name: Princess Euphemia li Britannia
characters.description: The Third Princess of Britannia, Euphemia is a rarity among the royal family: kind-hearted, plucky, innocent and sweet. She wantseveryoneto be happy. Yes, that includes even the Elevens — among them, the man she loves, Suzaku Kururugi. Actual Pacifist: Despite being a Britannian noble, she wishes for peace for all and hates that the Japanese are oppressed by her family's empire. Because of this, she actually ends up being Lelouch's most formidable enemy. Her cheerful smile and strong will to help those in need end up completely and decisively derailing his plans at the end of R1, andit took a complete and utterDiabolus ex Machinafor Lelouch not to end up completely succumbing to her plan. Adaptational Badass: In just about anyCode Geassmedia featuring her, Euphemia hates fighting and refuses to engage in any violenceunless external circumstances forces her into resorting to it. In the DS game,she can be recruited as a playable pilot in an alternate storyline...in a custom Siegfried Knightmare Giga Fortress. Affectionate Nickname: "Euphie", by default. Cornelia calls her this whenever they are alone and Lelouch and Nunnally call her by this name. Euphemia also insists that Suzaku address her by this when they are alone. All for Nothing: In theLost StoriesRoute Entanglement"Stairway to Harmony",Euphemia doesn't succumb to any massacre-triggering order and theSAZis allowed to flourish, and when its positive effects become clear, she manages to convince her siblings to do the same in other Areas. Despite the good lengths she went to to provide equality and recover Britannia's falling reputation, all of this is rendered moot thanks to C.C. helping Charles in activating the Ragnarök Connection early and killing everyone, delivering a rather bluntCruel Twist Endingto what was otherwise a happyAU.

characters.name: Princess Cornelia li Britannia
characters.description: Twenty-seven-year old — twenty-eight by the second season — Second Princess of Britannia and Area 11's Governor after the death of her brother Clovis.The brilliant,fascistic and widely-feared Commander-in-Chief of the Imperial Army, she is also strongwilled, xenophobic, and strict. Nevertheless, sheharbors a deep and genuine soft spot for her little sisterEuphemia. Ace Custom: Her Gloucester Knightmare Frame is unique for having a white cape and a set of horns on its head, setting it apart from the Gloucesters piloted by her top soldiers. Ace Pilot: Amongst the best Britannia has to offer. She seems to be second only to Suzaku, and Schneizel says she's as good as Marianne "The Flash", though it's quite possible he's exaggerating. Adaptational Nice Guy:Her recap timeline self is much less of a fascisticSocial Darwinistthan her main series counterpart. She doesn't commit a mass genocide of a Japanese ghetto just to draw Zero out, and she's much more willing to understand Lelouch's reasonings for his actions and forgive him for them, lessening herKarma Houdinistatus in the original timeline.Her appearance in theLost StoriesRoute Entanglementstory "Promise of Dawn" has her warm up to Kallen enough to get her instated as the Knight of Eleven, looking past her Half-Japanese heritage and prior actions as a Black Knight. Her recap timeline self is much less of a fascisticSocial Darwinistthan her main series counterpart. She doesn't commit a mass genocide of a Japanese ghetto just to draw Zero out, and she's much more willing to understand Lelouch's reasonings for his actions and forgive him for them, lessening herKarma Houdinistatus in the original timeline.

characters.name: Prince Schneizel el Britannia
characters.description: Second son of Emperor Charles and the Prime Minister of Britannia. This blond man in his late twenties is one of the main antagonists of the series. While he comes across as anAnti-Villaindue to his chivalrous demeanor, the true nature of his sinister and calculating personality is revealed when he assumes the role of Lelouch's principal nemesis in Season 2. What he lacks in typical Britannian royaltheatrics, he makes up for in efficiency, cunning, and sheer ruthlessness. InSuzaku Of The Counterattack, Suzaku becomes his knight. Adaptational Badass: As with most of the cast, Schneizel is a pilot option inCode Geass: Lelouch of the Rebellion Lost Stories. Notably, the version released alongside Chapter 13 of the second main story arc allows him to use theDamoclesas his personal Knightmare. Adaptational Heroism: InNightmare of Nunnallyhe actually supports Euphie and the rest in fighting against Charles. He's alsoDemoted to Extraso he'sambiguouslymore heroic than in canon. At the least, he definitely opposes Charles's plans andhas no immediate interest in the throne as he arranges for Euphie to have the votes to be declared Emperor. Aloof Big Brother: Stoic as noted above and both Nunnally and Lelouch himself admit that Schneizel is the only one to beat Lelouch in Chess. Always Someone Better: Schneizel is the only character who can consistently outstrategize even Lelouch. Unfortunately for him, Lelouch thinks fast on his feet and the one "victory" he fully scoresmaking the Black Knights betray "Zero"ends up biting his ass hard ultimately.He could be seen as aDeconstructionof this.By the final battle, Schneizel's previous successes against Lelouch have made him all but certain he will defeat Lelouch like he has always done. But unwillingness to go all the way (like when Rolo saved Lelouch from being killed by the Black Knights) means that he's given Lelouch enough time to learn from their past encounters. Hence, Lelouch deduces that Schneizelonly plays games where he w

characters.name: Prince Clovis la Britannia
characters.description: Prince of Britannia and governor of Area 11 prior to the start ofCode Geass. He was the first of Lelouch's relatives that he encounters(and kills)after acquiring the Geass. Alas, Poor Villain: If not from Lelouch, he was at the very least dearly loved and missed by the rest of his family. Cornelia in particular took his death rather hard and swore bloody revenge on Zero. Antagonistic Governor: Governor of Area 11 andStarter Villainof the series. Asshole Victim: Despite the tragic and pitiful nature of his death as well as Lelouch's unhappiness over it, he's still a smug racist who orders the mass murder of civilians to save his own ass which probably helped Lelouch's decision to kill him. Attack! Attack! Attack!: He makes it clear that the full extend of his military expertise extends to "throw everything at the enemy until they all die", which works against Ohgi's initially disorganized group, but really highlights his incompetence once that same group becomes militarized under Lelouch's order and begins to run circles around his entire squadrons.

characters.name: Prince Odysseus Eu Britannia
characters.description: First Prince of the royal family. He seems to be a rather kind man, but is utterly outclassed by the hypercompetent nature of most other royal children. Arranged Marriage: He was to be married to the Empress of the Chinese Federation butthe Black Knights put a stop to that. He doesn't mind either way. Black Sheep: By no means a complete screw-up, but he's completely inadequate when compared to his more active siblings. Lelouch even calls him a ridiculously ordinary man. Even Evil Has Loved Ones: Not so much that he's actively evil and moreso that he's complicitly evil, but he's glad that to learn that Lelouch and Nunnally are alive. Everybody Has Standards: He's shocked when Lelouch reveals thathe killed their father in aKlingon Promotion, and asks him to step down, believing it to be some sort of juvenile prank.

characters.name: Princess Guinevere du Britannia
characters.description: 1st princess in line for the throne, and the eldest sister in the royal family. Rarely seen in the series, but carries the usual attitude of Britannians. Even Evil Has Loved Ones:She seems to care for Carine considering that they frequently appear together as well as Odysseus.Upon learningLelouch killed their father, Guinevere attempts to retaliate using the royal guard, citing thathe killed the Emperor. Whether or not she actually cares about her father or just wants to keep her royal status or both isn't clear. She seems to care for Carine considering that they frequently appear together as well as Odysseus. Upon learningLelouch killed their father, Guinevere attempts to retaliate using the royal guard, citing thathe killed the Emperor. Whether or not she actually cares about her father or just wants to keep her royal status or both isn't clear. Everybody Has Standards: She's surprised to learn that Lelouch, her brother, is alive. Her reaction to his survival is neutral until he revealshe killed their father and claims the throne for himself, after which she orders the guards to kill him.

characters.name: Princess Carine ne Britannia
characters.description: The 5th princess in line for the throne, and third oldest out of the royal siblings. ABratty Half-Pintwho carries the typical Britannian arrogance. While largely a bit character in the original anime, she plays a slightly larger role inCode Geass: Oz the Reflection. Ascended Extra: While originally a minor character who shared scenes with the more consequential Guinevere, she gets more focus in theOzmanga, and manages to actually survive the bombing of Pendragon. The Cameo: Carine can be seen when Lelouch and Nunnally leave for Japan at the beginning of the first compilation movie.
