Even Evil Has Loved Ones:She and Guinevere seem to care for each other considering that they're always in each other's company, as well as Odysseus.She seems to care for Lelouch and Nunnally (or at least used to), as she's present when they leave for Japan, though she does appear to be irritated, whether at just being there or them having to leave is unknown.She's close enough to Marrybell that she almostbegsher to just give the Lancelot Trial to a group of invading terrorists rather than risk letting them kill her. She and Guinevere seem to care for each other considering that they're always in each other's company, as well as Odysseus.

characters.name: Princess Marrybell mel Britannia
characters.description: Marrybell mel Britannia is 88th in line to the throne of the Britannian Empire, and the founder and leader of the anti-terrorism organization "Glinda Knights" within the Britannian military. She is childhood friends with Oldrin Zevon and attended military academy with her. Marrybell's single-handed establishment of the Glinda Knights was triggered by the loss of her mother and younger sister in a terrorist attack when she was young. Although usually misunderstood as having just a lovely appearance and a gentle demeanor, she is a sharp and able person who possesses situational assessment and strategy-designing abilities and keeps others at a distance. All for Nothing: After encountering Jeremiah and having the Geass placed on her by Charles broken, Marrybell starts suffering nightmares over the night her mother and sister died. When Oiagros confronts her and reveals to herthat it was actually V.V. who killed her family, not terrorists, and Oldrin lied to her, telling her that it was her and not Marrybell to let him the terrorist who kill his sister and mother, she nearly breaks down upon realizing that all her ruthless behavior in fighting terrorists, even driving away her friends in the Glinda Knights, was all for nothing. Ambiguously Bi: While her feelings for Oldrin are all but text, it's unclear if she holds any similar feelings towards Lyre/Orpheus. While she did have Lyre occassionally use his Geass to make himself resemble Oldrin after their falling out, andOrpheus would admit hedoescare about Marrybell, it's unclear if Marrybell ever held romantic feelings for him.Even seven years later with the two living together in hiding in South Africa, while the two clearly care about each other its ambiguous if there's any romantic element to it, or if it's more akin to that of a loyal knight and his lady. Beware of the Nice Ones: Following the death of her mother and sister, Marrybell became ruthless and bloodthirsty. The only reason she's so nice is because of the in

characters.name: Prince Hannes gua Britannia
characters.description: Abusive Parents: His mother was horribly abusive to him in the hopes to make him the next Emperor. An Arm and a Leg: Has a habit of removing the limbs females in his presence whether they be female servants who made a mistake or his 10 wives who have already had all their arms and legs removed. Dude Looks Like a Lady: Described as someone who could be mistaken for a girl.

characters.name: Princess Lila la Britannia
characters.description: The younger sister of Clovis la Britannia. Appears in the mobile gameCode Geass: Maelstrom of Libra. Black Bra and Panties: Though with some of her outfits she doesn't seem to wear a bra. Canon Immigrant: While she debuts in a mobile game, she makes a brief appearance during the first compilation movie when Lelouch and Nunnally leave for Japan, Clovis stopping her from going to them. She later is shown with the rest of the royal family in a photo in the present. Marilyn Maneuver: Lila is shown doing this posehere◊. What Happened to the Mouse?: It's never clarified what became of her during the series proper. While thecompilation moviesshow her as part of the portrait depicting the, at the time, still living members sans Lelouch and Nunnally, it's never clarified if she was still in Pendragon or not. If she was, then it runs the risk of becomingUncertain Doomdue to Schneizel using a FLEIJA on it.Lost Storiesslightly expands on her story fromMaelstrom of Libra, adapting several elements.

characters.name: Princess Sherry me Britannia
characters.description: The eldest daughter of Charles zi Britannia and the former First Princess of Britannia. She gave up her royal title before her father's ascension to the throne. She married Jugo Sumeragi and has a daughter, Sakuya Sumeragi, the protagonist ofCode Geass: Rozé of the Recapture. She died at a young age due to illness. Abdicate the Throne: She was Charles' eldest daughter meaning if she stayed with the Royal family after Charles ascended to the throne, she would have become the First Princess of Britannia along with Odysseus, the First Prince. However, she gave up her claim before her father's ascension and Guinevere inherited her position as the First Princess instead. Happily Married: Her marriage with Jugo was a happy one. Posthumous Character: She died young before the story started. Remember the New Guy?: She existed inRoze of the Recapturebut wasn't mentioned in the original series and Guinevere was the First Princess and the eldest daughter in the Royal family. Sherry did give up the title before Charles became Emperor but her daughter Sakuya still has claims for the throne.

characters.name: V.V.
characters.description: V.V. (pronounced V2 and born as Victor zi Britannia) is a mysterious boy with blond hair longer than his body. He has gained the power of immortality through a Geass contract like C.C. He can grant Geass contracts like her, having given both the Emperor and Rolo Lamperouge their Geass abilities, among others in the Geass Order. Abdicate the Throne: V.V. is the elder twin, but opts to pass up the Britannian throne to Charles partially because people might notice he doesn't age. Abusive Parents: His contractors in the Geass Order,with his brother Charles being an exception,are essentially his "children" in spirit, with Clara Lefranc and Toto Thompson even calling him as their "father" inOz The Reflection. Said children of his were subjected to cruel experimentation under his watch to test the effects of their Geass and he has no qualm or care whether they live or die. He ordered that Orpheus and Euliya be hunted down and killed after they escaped the Order in Orpheus's backstory, which resulted in Euliya's death, personally shot and killedToto Thompsonnear the end of the first half of theOz The Reflectionseries for defying him whenshe tried to protect the Zevon Twins from the awful truth, didn't care at all thatClara was killed by Orpheus, and called Rolo a worthless failure to his face. Adaptational Intelligence: In theCompilation Movie, he foresawJeremiah's defection, considering it to be worth it because it still confirmed that Lelouch was Zero. Adapted Out: He doesn't exist in theNightmare of Nunnallyseriesas Charles is shown to be an only child in his flashbacks in that continuity as opposed to the main series, where he was V.V.'s younger twin brother. As a result, the culprit responsible for Marianne's murder in the spin-off series is someone else entirely.

characters.name: Ricardo von Britannia
characters.description: Founder of the Kingdom: He is the one who turned the former British Empire into the Holy Britannian Empire and made himself its first Emperor.

characters.name: Augusta Henry Highland
characters.description: Screw the Rules, I'm Doing What's Right!: He is someone who highly values honor and protecting the people, so when Julius Kingsley's plan deliberately puts civilians in danger, he refuses to abide it. Unfortunately for him, as Kingsley wields the Imperial Scepter, his word is considered that of the Emperor, so he has the Grand Duke arrested for treason and takes control himself.

characters.name: Michele Manfredi
characters.description: Alliterative Name:MicheleManfredi. Anti-Villain: Although nominally part of the Britannian elite, Michele seems genuinely nice, and holds Shin's Eastern heritage in high regard instead of disdain, remarking that he considers Shin as a brother and a likely successor in becoming the Grandmaster of the Knights of St. Michael in five years. Too bad Shin has other plans... Informed Attribute: He's said to be a former Knight of the Round, implying he was one of Britannia's greatest warriors. While his own Knightmare, which would be claimed by Shin and redubbed the Vercingetorix, is shown to be a terrifying weapon, he never gets to pilot it himself, instead being killed in his only living appearance, with all subsequent appearances being restricted to being a spirit. We Hardly Knew Ye: Manfredi gets about three minutes of screentime before being compelled into suicide by Shin.

characters.name: Shin Hyūga Shaing
characters.description: TheBig BadofCode Geass: Akito the Exiledand said hero's half-brother. Coming from fallen nobility (after killing his own family no less), Shaing is a born opportunist and manipulator - aided by his own Geass, no less, who has risen through the ranks of the Knights of St. Michael with both his skills and unscrupulous methods, to say the least. Despite his station, he's hungry with ambition - and brimming with utter madness. Abel And Cain: Akito and Shin are brothers and are trying to kill one another. Ace Custom: He pilots the 7th Generation Knightmare custom-built for Michel Manfredi, theSagramore, renamedVercingetorix. Which comes with a set of ludicrously strong custom weaponry like achainsawaxe, a one-handedGrenade Launcherand aBlaze Luminous Sword, on top of the mech being built with all terrains in mind by not relying on Knightmare Spinners for movement by moving like a centaurwith the jumping power of a cricket relative to it's size. Aloof Big Brother: Most likely played straight in the case of Akito.Zig-Zaggedin the case of his adopted sister Alice, since he treats her nicely and is even engaged to her, but episode 4 shows that he is more than perfectly willing to geass her into suicide. On the other hand, when he sees her ghost, he says that he wants to meet her, and prepares to kill himself to prove it. Ax-Crazy: It seems that craziness runs in the blood. Like with Akito, his mental health is really not in the best condition due to effects of Geass. His own, that is.

characters.name: Jean Rowe
characters.description: Ace Pilot: She puts up one hell of a fight against Suzaku and the Lancelot with a (considerably inferior) custom Gloucester. She's soundly beaten, but all the same, Suzaku hasn't had to work that hard for a victory since fighting Kallen last. Bodyguarding a Badass: Lampshaded in Episode 2. She offers to give Shin cover fire as he retreats from the battlefield, which he scoffs at as his Knightmare is more than a match for anything the EU can throw at him. The look on her face indicates that she's fully aware of this, butshe still wanted to do it for him. Can't Bathe Without a Weapon: She'sCrazy-Preparedenough to keep a gun with her while she's taking aShower of Angst. Cold Sniper: Her Gladius comes with a large sniper rifle. The Dragon: Shaing's right-hand woman and confidant. Or least as much of one as he'll allow her.

characters.name: Ashley Ashra
characters.description: Alliterative Name:AshleyAshra. Ax-Crazy: When he's first introduced; turns out to not be exactly true but he's pretty fierce in battle. Big Eater: Spends almost an entire scene eating a lot of sandwiches in episode 5. Then when he goes to talk to Jean, he eats her rations. Blood Knight: This guy loves war and violence. Sitting still for him is not an option. Unlike most examples though, he's not a malicious sociopath and actually can be decent and caring fellow. Defector from Decadence:After Smilas' death, like Akito, Leila and the rest of the Wyvern squad, he and his still living subordinates defect from the army andjoins themin living with the old Romani ladies.

characters.name: Asura Strike Force
characters.description: Taking the Bullet: Johannes jumps in front of Ashley to save him from being fatally impaled by Akito. His death is what drives Ashley to go after the Wyvern Squad for revenge. Undying Loyalty: They're extremely loyal to their leader, Ashley, and would follow him to the very end.So when Ashley decides to desert the military and join the Romani caravan with the rest of Wyvern Squad, they join him.

characters.name: Andrea Farnese
characters.description: Due to the Dead: Orders the honorable burial of their fallen after their defeat at Narva. Impractically Fancy Outfit: Though he commands from the rear, the collar of the robe he wears is large enough that one would think he'd have trouble seeing over it. Know When to Fold 'Em: Refuses to commit more troops to destroy the remnants of W-0, instead retreating. Sole Survivor: He's the last remaining Grand Master after Shin's failed coup d'etat.

characters.name: Maria Shaing
characters.description: A Euro Britannian noblewoman and the mother of Alice, she is also the adoptive mother of Shin Hyuga Shaing. Blue Blood: A noble of Euro-Britannia Died Happily Ever After: Neither she nor Alice hated Shin for murdering them. Good Parents: She was this to Shin despite not knowing about his true mental state. Even after death, she did her best along with the spirits of Alice, Manfredi, and Shin's birth mother to persuade him not to kill Akito and was crucial in bringing Shin back to his senses. Like a Son to Me: Maria loved Shin just like he was her own despite him not being Britannian or her son by birth.

characters.name: Alice Shaing
characters.description: Maria Shaing's daughter and the fiancee of her adopted brother Shin Hyuga Shaing. Blue Blood: A young noble of Euro-Britannia Died Happily Ever After: Neither she nor Maria hated Shin for murdering them. She lampshades this in the final episode. Disappeared Dad: Alice's father is never mentioned; it's implied Maria has been a widow as far back as when she adopted Shin as a child. Kill the Cutie: She's so sweet it hurts when Shin kills her with his Geass.

characters.name: Callis al Britannia
characters.description: The leader of Neo-Britannia and self-proclaimed 100th Emperor of Britannia. Blood from the Mouth:He bleeds from the mouth when he's assassinated in Episode 3. Death of a Child:He's assassinated by Norland so Sakuya (or rather, a disguised Sakura) can be installed as the 101st Empress of Britannia. The Emperor: Of Neo-Britannia. Light Is Good: Callis is an innocent kid who hardly understands a thing about the barbaric regime he's a figure head for and his nature is highlighted by his white robes, contrasting his dark, scheming advisor Norland.

characters.name: Norland von Lunebelg
characters.description: A leading figure in the Neo Britannian Empire and advisor to the Emperor, and serves as the White King and leader of the Einberg. He is formerly a Knight of the Round. Abusive Parents:As hinted by Ash during his conversation with Narah, Norland raised Ash as an assassin, and Ash despises him for what he did to him. The seventh episode shows that Norland doesn't care about Ash's actual younger brother, Nichol, because he's too weak and executes him for cleaning up his brother's mistake. Allegorical Character:Whether intentional or not, Norland is a living representation of Schneizel's views on humanity, and what he himself wanted to become during the events ofR2. Schneizel believed that humans were driven solely by ambitions and ulterior motives, incapable of genuine altruism. Norland was created by those exact kinds of people, who selfishly clung to Charles's legacy and beliefs and wanted to bring him back. Lacking in any emotions of his own and left with no purpose, Norland decides that as a clone he is a being superior to humans and gains ambitions to destroy them all. Artificial Human:Norland is revealed to have been a clone created by Britannian scientists of Emperor Charles as aBackup Body Drivein the event of the Emperor's death. As Long as It Sounds Foreign: Judging by the pronouciation of both the Japanese and English voice actors, his name is likely a reference to Lüneburg, but it's officially spelled "Lunebelg" instead.

characters.name: Natalia Luxembourg
characters.description: The only daughter of the Luxembourg family and a close associate of Sherry me Britannia. She is one of the central figures in the administration of the Neo-Britannian Empire. Classy Cravat: She wears a red cravat that makes her look very refined. Cool Big Sis: She cares a lot about Callis and looks after him, having even saved him from a terrorist attack once, and Callis is similarly a lot more cheerful around her.She isn't able to stop his death, unfortunately. Damsel out of Distress:Despite being arrested on charges of treason by Neo-Britannia and Christoph unsubtly implying to a captured Sakuya that he'd use her for his Geass experiments, Natalia somehow managed to escape and made her way to a military shelter during the onslaught of L.O.K.I drones across the world. Letting Her Hair Down: While working she keeps her hair tied back, making her look professional, but lets it loose off-duty.

characters.name: Narah Vaughan
characters.description: One of Neo-Britannia's Einberg, holding the rank of Black Queen in the Schwarzritter. Ace Custom: The "Queen Asura", compared to her comrades' identical Knightmare platforms. Awesomeness by Analysis: She's able to quickly realize that her attacker was likely Ash after narrowly avoiding getting killed by hissignature strategy. Bifauxnen: She has more boyish looks compared to her fellow Einberg Catherine due to her short hair and modest wardrobe.This wasn't the case when she was a kid - especially in a photo right besides Ash in his younger years. Blade Below the Shoulder: HerQueen Asuracomes with retractable blades on each arm.

characters.name: Catherine Sabathra
characters.description: The "White Queen" of the Neo-Britannian Empire's Einberg Order. Ace Custom: TheQueen Curaca, compared to her comrades' identical Knightmare platform. Affably Evil: While she constantly disparages "Sakuya" for being weak in her eyes, when she's talking to those she actually respects she's playful and casual. Ambiguously Brown: Implied, if the name Sabathra (which is the name of a location in Libya) and her dark skin mean anything, alongside her Queen Curaca being named after a place in Brazil. It's unclear as to whether she hailed from one of the other Areas, or directly from the Britannian homeland itself. As Libya is not part of the Britannian Empire in any form while Brazil is, it's likely the latter and it should be noted that Brazil really does have large a large latinized Middle Eastern and North African population in it. As with another dark skinned Britannian pilot, Villetta Nu, whatever her ancestor was is obviously now irrelevant to Britannia. I Am Not Left-Handed: TheQueen Curacais later shown bare-handed, fending off blows from Haruka's Keisetsu trying to punch it. Even without her guns, Catherine still knows how to fight in melee.

characters.name: Walther Lindstedt
characters.description: The "Black Bishop" of the Neo-Britannian Empire's Einberg Order. Blue Is Calm: His color scheme is blue and he's the calmest and least confrontational of the Einberg. Deducing the Secret Identity:At the end of Episode 6, he corners Sakura after shes taken her bath and reveals that he knows her true identity. Green Rooming: Despite being introduced alongside the rest of the Einberg in Episode 3, he doesn't speak or have a role until Episode 6. Token Good Teammate: Despite mentioning he killed Japanese people in the past, he's easily the least antagonistic of all the Einberg and he never personally battles the heroes.

characters.name: Stanley Vonbraun
characters.description: The "White Bishop" of the Neo-Britannian Empire's Einberg Order. Does Not Like Magic: Despises Geass, to the point ofleaking Christoph's lab location to the rebels to stop his studying of magic. Enigmatic Minion: He's easily the most mysterious and least focused of all the members of the Einberg Order.At the time of his death, he does show somestandards, but that's about it. Evil Genius: Norland values ​​him not for his combat or tactical skills, but for his high level of technological knowledge and development. The Mole:He's the one who leaked to Kuroto and Ash about Sakuya/Roze's location. His motives aside from disliking the Geass are unknown.Before he gets crushed by the L.O.K.I., he manages to send its blueprints to Gino who gives this information to the UFN.

characters.name: Christoph Scissorman
characters.description: The "Black Rook" of the Neo Britannian Empire's Einberg Order. He has been friends with Norland the longest. Badass Teacher: Christoph is a combat instructor who's a very skilled Knightmare pilot. Break Them by Talking: He tries to do this on Ash during their Knightmare fight by reminding himthat Sakuya Geassed him, used him as a pawn for her own means, and might dispose of him once everything's over. Contrasting Sequel Antagonist: To V.V., both are closest to theBig Bad(V.V. being Charles’s older twin brother and Christoph being Norland’s most loyal friend). While V.V. is an immortal Code Bearer who looks like a child while in realityis actually chronologically in his early 60'sdue to receiving his Code at a very young age. Christoph, on the other hand is a regular old man who actually does look his age. Furthermore, V.V. was head of a secret organization, the Geass Directorate that had successfully produced Geass Users while Christoph attempted to produce an army of Geass Users through his research, but his attempt ended in failure. Defiant to the End: When Sakuya tries tocommand him with her Geass, he spitefully shoots himself, shouting that he'll never be her pawn before he dies.

characters.name: Divock Merte
characters.description: The "White Rook" of the Neo Britannian Empire's Einberg Order. Backpack Cannon: The massive cannon of his Elcarmal Knightmare is on its backpack. Be Careful What You Wish For: He wanted to see Sapporo crushed by the Damocles. Too bad he's not around to see it, nor was itbecauseof him -rather than getting blown to bits by the F.L.E.I.J.As on the Damocles, Sapporo instead faces gettingliterallycrushed by the Damocles when Christoph fires the last F.L.E.I.J.A at it to make it fall. The Brute: Looks and acts the part. Detrimental Determination: Despite being ordered to retreat after the Damocles sustains too much damage with his forces being overrun, he still stubbornly attempts to fulfill his mission to nuke the Sapporo Ghetto. In his last futile attempt, he personally carries the F.L.E.I.J.A. with his Knightmare, only to fail when Roze and Ash fire the F.L.E.I.J.A. Eliminator at him, leading to his death.

characters.name: Arnold Renck
characters.description: The "Black Knight" of the Neo Britannian Empire's Einberg Order. He is an advisor who is devoted to Norland. Ace Custom: He upgrades from his Valpnir to the more powerful Lohengrinafter being upgraded by Christoph. Affectionate Nickname: Catherine calls him Arnie. Anti-Magic:Like Jeremiah, Arnold has his own version of the Geass Canceller which he used on Ash, restoring his old memories including his memories of Nichol, his actual dead little brother. Though Arnold does this to mentally torture Ash into reliving Nichol's execution. Ax-Crazy:After Christoph restores him, Arnold becomes obsessed with wanting to defeat the Nameless Mercenaries, especially Ash.

characters.name: Heath Lott
characters.description: The "White Knight" of the Neo Britannian Empire's Einberg Order. He's fiercely competitive with Arnold. Ate His Gun: Commits suicide by shooting himself in the head. Broken Tears: He becomes a sobbing mess as he has a breakdown and panic attack when Norland dismisses him for his failure. Driven to Suicide: He kills himself almost immediately after Norland drops him from the Einbergs for his failure against the Seven Shining Stars. Even Evil Has Standards:He's horrified when Norland executes Nichol, who is just a kid.

characters.name: Greede Kirkwayne
characters.description: The "White Pawn" of the Neo Britannian Empire's Einberg Order. Boom, Headshot!: Greede meets his end when Sakuya's Geass makes him turn his own gun on himself and blow his brains out. Brains and Brawn: His brother fights in a Knightmare while Greede watches from the sidelines and views the battle to think out the strategy. Evil Redhead: He and his brother are redheads and deplorable Britannians. Faux Affably Evil: While at first he tries to act more reasonable than his brother, when a woman gives him aSpiteful Spitfor murdering her husband, he mercilessly guns her down while decrying Elevens as nothing but uncivilized cattle.

characters.name: Gran Kirkwayne
characters.description: The "Black Pawn" of Neo Britannian Empire's Einberg Order. He is Greede's younger brother. Brains and Brawn: The fighting Knightmare pilot to his brother's role as the tactician of the duo. The Brute: Gran lacks even his brother's ability to put on a facade of civility and instead delights in sadistically killing and tormenting the Japanese. Tellingly, he acts as the muscle while Greede hangs back to give the less intelligent sibling tactical advice. Dirty Coward: Ash refers to him as a fearful man who ensured he only ever fought against helpless people, which hindered his combat ability, while killing Gran. Evil Redhead: He and his brother are redheads and they're deplorable Britannians.

characters.name: Li Xingke
characters.description: A minor officer within the Chinese Federal Military, Li Xingke swore his loyalty and life to the young Empress Tianzi after she saved him from being executed for showing mercy to a prisoner. Now he has dedicated his life to climbing the ladder of the Chinese Military to gain enough power to overthrow the de facto rulers of the Federation, the Eunuchs, and grant the Empress her greatest wish: to see the outside world. Considering the fact that he is said, and has mostly proven, to have both the strength of Suzaku and the intelligence of Lelouch, this is very likely. The Ace: This guy is one of the few examples in the show to truly qualify. Lelouch describes him as being just as smart and clever as himself and also as physically strong and skilled as Suzaku. Ace Pilot: He's as skilled in his mech as he is in person. Awesome, but Impractical: Xingke in general is kind of this. Although his combo of both Lelouch and Suzaku's strengths mean he's able to create impressive strategies and carry them out personally, his disease means his body almost always gives out on him at the worst possible moment, leaving him less effective than he should be. Blood from the Mouth: Happens to him once in a while during battle. He always mentions having a few more moments whenever it happens, but somehow survives till the end.

characters.name: Jiang Lihua aka Empress Tianzi
characters.description: The Empress of China, who appears in R2. Technically speaking, the Tianzi ("Child of Heaven") is supposed to be the leader of the Chinese Federation and the heir to the old imperial tradition. In reality, the current Tianzi is a teenage girl kept away from her people by her council, the Eunuchs, who rule the country as they wish. However, not everything is lost: Tianzi has a protector in Li Xingke, and even if she's powerless at the moment, she's touchingly determined to do what she can. Arranged Marriage:The Emperor tries to marry his eldest son Prince Odysseus off to her, which Lelouch and the Black Knights use to their advantage. Diethard also suggests this following their victory over the High Eunuchs, and Lelouch considers it... except the rest of the main party tells Diethard off (to Zero's face), so Lelouch instead goes off to try to figure things out. He gets a call from Shirley and decides to ask her for advice and Shirley reminds him that he himself does a lot of what he does for love himself so forcing such a thing on the Tianzi would be wrong. A Child Shall Lead Them: Li Xingke's ultimate goal is to repay Empress Tianzi's kindness by giving her enough power to rule over the Federation, instead of being just a puppet of the Eunuchs. Damsel in Distress: Li Xingke is motivated to action by rescuing her from the High Eunuchs and taking her to the outside world. The Empress: Of the Chinese Federation but it's in-name only because the High Eunuchs control her.

characters.name: High Eunuchs
characters.description: A circle of the Empress's advisers who run the country under her shadow. They seek personal gain even if it means betraying their whole country. In Chinese Federation arc of R2, they agree to lend the Black Knights land for the million Japanese exiles and recognize their state of the United States of Japan. However, they also collaborate with Schneizel to hand the Empress and their territory over in return for Britannian noble titles. Asshole Victim:Very few if any people will cry over their deaths. Bondage Is Bad: For some reason for restraints they sanction the use of belts and straps rather than cuffs (or straitjackets in Britannia's case) and ball gags instead of muzzles. Also, when they present a capturedKallento the Britannian forces as aPOW, she is strapped to a flat surface with an overkill amount of belts. Bright Is Not Good: Wear bright white, yellow, and orange robes and among the worstHate Sinksin the series. Eunuchs Are Evil: Men lacking both morals and manhood, they're eviler than the Black Knights and Britannians both.

characters.name: Colonel Ren
characters.description: Bad Boss: He abandons his men to save himself, viewing them as sacrificial pawns. Dirty Coward: He decides to save his own skin when losing the battle against the Black Knights and abandon his followers who trusted him. Hate Sink: A cruel and greedy warlord who extorts a local village and enslaves its inhabitants to enrich himself. Having his soldiers execute anyone who couldn’t work regardless of whether they are or not.

characters.name: Mao
characters.description: A Chinese orphan whomthe immortal woman C.C.finds as a six-year-old boy and whom she "gifts" with theGeasspower oftelepathy. As happens with Geass,he loses control of it, forcing him to listen to everyone's thoughts constantly and involuntarily, without any possibility of blocking them — except by avoiding human contact altogether. Thus his telepathy has the tragic side effect of rendering him completely, permanently, and irrevocably dependent on C.C. forallof his social needs. For a time, as part of her "contract" with him, she takes care of him, lives with him in the wild, and helps shield him from the intruding thoughts of the world, during which time he fallscompletely in love with her. When the time comes to fulfill their contract, he proves unable or unwilling to do so, though it isn't until much later in the series that we learn her wishis to die, making this come offHarsher in Hindsight.She abandonshim,confident that his Geass will prevent him from ever going among people again, and he goesinsane. Now Mao's one desire is tofind and keephis eternally beloved C.C. (seeYandere)— to hell with anyone else,especiallyanyone who gets in their way. Abduction Is Love: He tries to kidnap C.C. and take her to a house he bought in remoteAustraliawhere they can live away from all the thoughts his Geass forces him to hear. Accentuate the Negative: Basically the core of his variousMore than Mind Controlattempts. He doesn't lie, but he does focus on the worst possible interpretation, although he's merely reading their mind. Adapted Out: He ends up absent in theCompilation Movieseries as well as in theLost Storiesmobile game, leading to some notable changes without him, though it's implied that his plotline still happened inLost Storiesas Shirley's father still died like in the original series unlike in the Compilation Movies, which means that Mao is simply offscreen in the game for the most part.

characters.name: Gene Smilas
characters.description: A general of the E.U. army. He is Leila's direct superior and as well as mentor. Ambition Is Evil:He wants to rule over the E.U. as its emperor. Asshole Victim:No one sheds any tears when Ashley kills him. Big Good:Subverted. He's actually a power hungry man out to rule over the Union as its emperor. Bitch in Sheep's Clothing:While he outwardly appears to be committed to the EU's cause, in reality he only cares about gaining power for himself.

characters.name: Pierre Anou
characters.description: The ex-commanding officer of W-0, who also happens to be racist. Gets replaced by Leila in the first OVA episode. Armchair Military: Anou acts like this for the few minutes he's on screen, and gets called on it by Leila due to him ordering the W-0 unit to self-destruct in order to take out enemy Knightmares when it would serve no practical purpose. Bad Boss: Anou sees the Eleven as expendable soldiers and threatens Leila with a gun. Beard of Evil: Not exactly evil, but he has a goatee and is a total asshat. Evil Is Petty: Leaves the W-0 Unit on the streets of a foreign city out of nothing but spite for having him removed from command.

characters.name: Margaret Walpole
characters.description: A Child Shall Lead Them: Despite being no older than Nunnally, Tianzi, and Kaguya, she becomes President of the E.U. Early-Bird Cameo: She first appears during the ending montage of the picture drama "Code Geass: The Miraculous Birthday" during Nunnally's segment, with no indication as to her identity. She wouldn't make a proper appearance until the manga adaptation ofCode Geass: Lelouch of the Re;surrection, which wouldn't be released until 2020,ten yearsafter her cameo.

characters.name: Romero Barclay
characters.description: Hero Antagonist: He is a General of the European Union who is fighting back against Britannia’s invasion led by Suzaku and the Knights of the Round.

characters.name: Akito Hyuga
characters.description: The main protagonist and titular character ofCode Geass: Akito the Exiled. He's a member of the special unit W-0 (Wyvern Squad) of the Europia United army. After a disastrous first operation he's left as the sole survivor of the unit's initial batch of Japanese pilots. Quiet and reserved, he's an incredibly skilled combatant whose prowess in battle earns him the nickname "Ghost of Hannibal" from the Euro-Britannia army. He also serves as Leila Malcal's bodyguard and even gives her advice at times. Ace Custom: He gains one in the final episode known as the Alexander Liberte, which is Akito's original Alexander unit upgraded with the latest technology that the W-0 could afford to put on it. Ace Pilot: The best one that the W-0 has to offer. Ax-Crazy: Not by choice. As a boy, he was geassed by his older brother Shin to "die". However, as Akito was still a child at the time and thus too young to understand the concept of death, the order failed to register and he ended up living. However, the order itself remained within his psyche and eventually translated intokilling everything that stood in his pathwhen activated in battle. This later goes away thanks to Leila and his friends continuously reaching out to Akito to not give in to the order and eventually succeed. The Berserker: His battle style when piloting a Knightmare, especially in theAlexander.

characters.name: Leila Malcal
characters.description: The main heroine ofCode Geass: Akito the Exiled. She is Akito Hyuga's superior who serves asThe Strategistand later commander of the W-0 unit. Though a member of the E.U. army, she's actually Britannian by birth but was raised in the E.U. after her family defected thanks to disagreeing with the Britannian Empire's policies and system. She develops a friendship with Akito early on, often asking him about what he thinks regarding certain matters, and later falls in love with him. Action Girl: Leila is accomplished in aikido and possibly jujutsu, which she demonstrates to anyone unfortunate enough to think she's a soft target. All Girls Want Bad Boys: Akito is, atthe best of times, broody and mentally unstable when they first get acquainted, but this doesn't stop the morally upright and clasically trained Leila from slowly becoming infatuated with him. All-Loving Hero: She's an idealist who believes in the best of humanity despite its evils andeverything that she went through in her childhood. Though her kindness does have limits, she is not one who can bear others ill will for long. Ultimately, her desire is for humanity to understand each other, friend and foe alike.This is reflected in her Geass, which lets her connect people's thoughts and consciousness with each other. A Mother to Her Men: Fiercely protective of anyone under her command.

characters.name: Ryo Sayama
characters.description: A Japanese youth in charge of a terrorist cell based out in Europia. Together with his friends Ayano and Yukiya, all three are conscripted into the W-0 unit after their failure to kidnap General Gene Smilas in an attempt to steal the latest Knightmare Frame that the E.U. had to offer. Though initially unimpressed with Akito and Leila, he's quick to warm-up to them after their mission in Slonim. Fire-Forged Friends: With Akito and Leila, especially the former, by the end of Episode 2. Hidden Depths: Despite his bravado, he admits that he only really wants to find a home for himself and his two friends; he grows to enjoy the company of the old Roma women near Warsaw precisely because their caravan becomes something of a second home to him and the rest of Wyvern. Hot-Blooded: To the point he's the sort of guy who uses punching to settle arguments without any real ill will behind it. Irony: A small one as it never actually gets brought up during the story. Prior to joining the W-0 unit, Ryo was in charge of a group that had preciselyelevenmembers. This in a series where the Japanese arecalledElevens.

characters.name: Ayano Kosaka
characters.description: A young Japanese girl from Ryo's terrorist group. Together with Ryo and Yukiya, she was conscripted into W-0 unit after their failure to kidnap General Smilas. Ancestral Weapon: She has a kodachi passed down to her from the days when her family were still samurai. It's taken by Leila after Ayano and her friends are conscripted into the W-0 unit and later given to Akito so that he could return it once their mission in Slonim was over. Once she finds out, Ayano instead decides to let him keep it in the hope that it'll bring him good luck. Buxom Beauty Standard: Ayano is just as well-endowed in the bust department as Leila, which doesn't sit well with Anna in one of thePicture Dramas. Can't Hold Her Liquor: In aPicture Drama. She turns into a crying drunk just from the smell of sake. Expy: Somewhat serves as one to Kallen from the original series. Although she isn't aHot-BloodedLadette, instead being a calmerTomboy with a Girly Streak.

characters.name: Yukiya Naruse
characters.description: The third member of Ryo's terrorist group. Yukiya excels at collecting data and handling explosives. Like his boss and Ayano, he's also conscripted into joining the E.U. army's W-0 unit after their failed kidnapping attempt of General Smilas. Boomerang Bigot: A member of an oppressed people is himself racist towards his own people. Character Development: By the final two episodes he's learned to care deeply about his new friends in the W-0 unit. The Cracker: He hacked into a military-grade security systemundetected, though he (mostly) settles for less malicious forms of hacking after hisHeel–Face Turn. Determinator: As best shown in Episode 5, even while still in recovery from his injuries, the guy simply refuses to just lay down while the rest of the squad are fighting for their lives.

characters.name: Anna Clément
characters.description: The scientist responsible for developing the special Knightmare Frame of the W-0 unit the Alexander. She is a childhood friend of Leila. A-Cup Angst: In aPicture Drama, she reveals this to be the reason she was covering her chest area when she, Leila and Ayano get drunk off the smell of sake while soaking in a hot spring, though she claims that her chest is normal; Leila and Ayano's are just too big. Bridge Bunnies: Serves as one during missions. Can't Hold Her Liquor: In aPicture Drama. She turns into an angry drunk off the smell of sake. Childhood Friends: With Leila.

characters.name: Claus Warwick
characters.description: Leila's aide-de-camp. The Alcoholic: Is perpetually disheveled and carries a drink with him. Becoming the Mask:Despite being a Britannian mole, he grows to genuinely care about the rest of W-0, and ends up siding with them when Euro-Britannia assaults their base. Bunny-Ears Lawyer: Despite his eccentricities, he's an excellent officer. The Cynic: And rather exasperated at his CO's idealism.

characters.name: Oscar Hammel
characters.description: The vice captain of the Guard Troops at W-0's headquarters. 11th-Hour Ranger:Downplayed. He'd long established himself as a member ofwZEROby then, but mostly remained in the command center up until the attack on Castle Weisswolf, at which point he joins the battle himself piloting Leila's Alexander Type-02 and leading the drones. As a result, he's able to sense Akito nearly succumb to Shin's Geass via the Brain Raid System, and calls out to him with the others while he's sword-fighting Shinvia Leila's Geass. Not So Stoic: He tends to be rather serious and straitlaced, but does let his emotions show occassionally. Following the success of the E.U. offensive in Episode 2 he grins and does a fist pump, though he quickly resumes his regular expression. Reasonable Authority Figure: When Leila takes command of W-0 from Anou, he has no objections and even helps subdue the latter. Stoic Spectacles: As mentioned above he's rather serious individual compared to his comrades in the W-0 unit.

characters.name: Shamna
characters.description: The High Priestess of Zilkhistan, and theBig BadofCode Geass: Lelouch of the Re;surrection. Barred from the Afterlife: Lelouch could only defeat her by trapping her in a time loop where she's repeatedly killed and her Geass sends her back to a time where she's unconscious. As a result, her soul is trapped between life and death for all eternity. C.C. offers her a chance to escape her fate and pass on. Due to her own heart losing its way, leading her brother and her people down countless failed paths and leading them astray, Shamna decides to remain so as to meet them all as they pass on asatonement for failing them. Big Bad: Her brother may be the king of Zilkhistan, but she isThe Woman Behind the Man. Death-Activated Superpower: Her Geass ofMental Time Travelis only activated when she dies. Even Evil Has Loved Ones: She truly loves her little brother a lot.

characters.name: Shalio
characters.description: The young king of Zilkhistan. Action Politician: The king of Zilkhistan and their representative. He is also bar none their best Knightmare pilot and warrior. Ax-Crazy: His obsession with battle didn't cost him just his eyes and body. His mind is a hornet's nest, and he has a tendency to completely lose his shit at the smallest things. That's nothing to say that he turns into a frothing lunatic during battle. Blood Knight: He's completely obsessed with becoming the most powerful warrior. The Chains of Commanding: Trying to become a warrior strong enough to fight for his people wrecked his body futher and drove him insane.

characters.name: Bolvona Forgnar
characters.description: A legendary Zilkhistan war hero who commands the country's armies. Ace Pilot: Proves capable of matchingCorneliain a one on one battle,ending in both Knightmares being destroyed. A Father to His Men: His men care deeply for their generalissimo.This backfires on him when heorders them to kill him and Cornelia, as his men refuse to kill someone they admire so much, even if it costs them the battle. Outliving One's Offspring:Lelouch kills his son Shesthal during the prison break. Red Baron: He is known as the "Brown Bulwark" for his prowess in battle.

characters.name: Shesthal Forgnar
characters.description: The captain of the royal guard and the son of the legendary Generalissimo Forgnar. Oh, Crap!: He's last seen with a look of horror asLelouch detonates a sakuradite bomb right in front of him. Smug Snake: He assumes that his nobility makes him a master tactician. Upper-Class Twit: He is very proud of his nobility, even though his family were merchant class before his father became a war hero.

characters.name: Swaile Qujappat
characters.description: An assassin who serves Zilkhistan. He has a Geass that renders his targets unable to tell friend from foe. Confusion Fu: His Geass causes his targets to see their allies as copies of him and to see him as their allies. Even if an opponent realizes that they are under an illusion, they still have to contend with Qujappat's skills in conventional combat. Graceful Loser:As Nina fatally electrocutes him, he compliments her on being able to outwit him. Kick the Dog: He shoots C.C. in the head without any reason to assume that she was anything more than a civilian in the wrong place at the wrong time.

characters.name: Belq Batoum Bitool
characters.description: The corrupt warden of Zilkhistan's most secure prison. Animal Mecha: His personal machine is the "Batalalan Du," a Knight Giga Fortress that takes the shape of a scorpion. Animal Motifs: His "Batalalan Du" is a Knight Giga Fortress that looks like a scorpion, reflecting his vicious nature. Bad Boss: When Kallen kills a bunch of his minions, he screams their names... to celebrate how he won't have to split his earnings with them anymore. Boxed Crook: He used to be a thief before he was appointed warden.

characters.name: Orpheus Zevon
characters.description: Orpheus Zevon is the twin brother of Oldrin Zevon. Born into nobility but abandoned by his parents so that Oldrin may succeed as the heir of the family according to its traditions, he was raised by a peasant family. However he was conscripted into the Geass Order against his will, using him as an assassin. Though he has long since broken ties with the Order, the cost was too great, and his lover Euliya died in the escape. When he discovered that his old family had a hand in his lover's death, he swore vengeance and returned to the battlefield. Ace Custom: Byakuen, the brother unit of the Guren Mk II. He temporarily abandons it during his time as "Lyre" in favor of the Vincent Gram, but regains it for the joint operation between Peace Mark and the Glinda Knights on the Damocles. Child Soldiers: He becomes one for PM after he joins their ranks. Eyepatch of Power:He's sporting an eyepatch over his right eye inCode Geass: Rozé of the Recapture, and hasn't lost any of his skill piloting a Knightmare Frame. Half-Identical Twins: He and Oldrin are twins and look very similar to each other.

characters.name: Ze Dien
characters.description: Ze Dien is a terrorist who is connected to “Peace Mark”. He is a young man originally from the Chinese Federation. He performs requests using a customized Glasgow he bought on the black market and remodeled to his preferences. He works together with Orpheus on missions along with Ganabati. Far East Asian Terrorists: A Chinese terrorist from the Chinese Federation. Purple Is Powerful: His clothes and Knightmare are purple and he's quite skilled.

characters.name: Ganabati
characters.description: An Indian man of Sikh origin, he's an engineer and merchant who helps out in PM. He's also the designated driver for the truck that carries theKMFsused by Ze and Orpheus.

characters.name: Miss X
characters.description: A mysterious woman who serves as PM's liaison officer with the outside world. Long-Lost Relative:She's implied to be Euliya mel Britannia, Marrybell's deceased sister. Oldrin is reminded of Marrybell when she meets Miss X, and a redesign of the latter reveals that her hair is naturally red, with its blond appearance being the result of hair dye. Additionnally,Word of Godis that Marrybell was intentionally given an outfit like Miss X's in her cameo inRozé of the Recapture, further implying that the two are siblings. Mysterious Past: Nothing's known about her, including her real name and nationality.

characters.name: Wizard/ Oiagros Zevon
characters.description: Wizard is a mysterious masked man who styles himself as a “magician”, and is a financial supporter of Peace Mark. He possesses vast information and assets, and is said to be very reliable, but his hidden background and identity have many grounds for suspicion. He toys with the two “Oz”s, Oldrin Zevon and Orpheus Zevon, whose identities and pasts he is apparently aware of. He pilots the black Knightmare Frame, Agravain. In reality, he is Oiagros Zevon, the uncle of both Oldrin and Orpheus Zevon, and the head of the minor noble Zevon family. He is also the leader of the Britannian organization "Pluton", which has carried out dirty jobs for the Britannian Imperial Family under the direction of the Zevon family for generations. In addition, he is the one responsible for killing Orpheus' lover Euliya on orders from the Geass Order, and is the enemy that Orpheus hunts and seeks revenge against. The Atoner:He is tortured by a guilty conscience for killing his older sister in order to take over as the head of the Zevon family five years ago, and furthermore killing his nephew (or so he believed at the time) on a mission. Because of this, he supports an anti-Britannian organization under the name of Wizard while being the head of "Pluton", and tries to support and protect both Orpheus and Oldrin in various situations as a way of atonement. Ace Custom: Agravain, the successor to the Gawain and predecessor to the mass-produced Gareths.

characters.name: Naoto Kozuki
characters.description: Cool Big Bro: Kallen adored him and still speaks fondly of him today. Heroic Bastard: Much like his sister, he's the result of an affair between a Britannian nobleman and Japanese citizen and yet helped lead a resistance. Heterosexual Life-Partners: With Ohgi back when he was alive. Posthumous Character: Died long before the start of the series.

characters.name: Ms. Kōzuki
characters.description: Earn Your Happy Ending:After Lelouch's death, her daughter moves back in with her and they're evidently very happy again. Outliving One's Offspring: Her son died before the start of the series. Unnamed Parent: We never find out what her first name is.

characters.name: Tatewaki Katase
characters.description: Everyone Has Standards: Despite opposing Britannia's rule over Japan he was opposed to Kusakabe holding Britannian civilians as hostages.

characters.name: Josui Kusakabe
characters.description: He Who Fights Monsters: As a member of the Japan Liberation Front he fought to free Japan from Britannia's rule, however his methods and actions such as holding a hotel full of Britannian civilians hostage and having them thrown off the roof the longer his demands aren't met makes him no better than those he opposes.

characters.name: Caretaker of Spacetime
characters.description: The collective consciousness of the Universe. They are a seer who watches the balance of the world from within. They do not exist for ordinary people, but exist for those who are able to see them. All-Powerful Bystander: They're neutral in the events of the world, but they can influence it occasionally. Anthropomorphic Personification: Of the consciousness of the Universe.The same one Charles and Marianne wanted to rewrite. The Bus Came Back: Following the conclusion ofAkito the Exiled, they were nowhere to be seen for quite some time, but is finally set to return in a major role inGenesic Re;Code. Humanity on Trial: They tell Leila that they believe humans are nothing but pitiful, defective, selfish creatures, and that bestowing them with a Geass was a big mistake. However, through their intrigue over Leila's selflessness and altruistic nature, the Caretaker entertains the notion that their opinion on humanity could ultimately be disproven, so they give humanity one more chance to do so.

characters.name: The Skull
characters.description: A powerful and malevolent entity that "gifted" Shin Hyuga Shaing with his Geass - for a very costly price. Its origins, or true nature for that matter, are a complete mystery. The Devil: If the Caretaker can be described as an avatar of the collective consciousness (itself God in the Code Geass universe), then this would likely be the devil. Deal with the Devil: It simply "gives" Shin his Geass with no price, but it becomes quickly apparent there's a terrible catch. Namely, Shin's ensuingSanity Slippageand being forced toconstantly see the spirits of those he used it on. Eldritch Abomination: By far the most "inhuman" entity in the series yet - it's nothing but a floating skull with a Code on it that comes and goes like a ghost. Greater-Scope Villain: Of Akito The Exiled - and possibly more than that. Half of the series wouldn't have come to pass if it hadn't given Shin a madness-inducing Geass.

characters.name: Sakuya Sumeragi
characters.description: Rozé/Sakuya's childhood friend and lookalike who serves as her body double. Body Double: She isn't the real Sakuya, but a public double for the real one who is currently posing as Rozé. The only major difference they have is that her irises are fully purple while Sakuya's has a blue ring near the pupil. Childhood Friends: She has been friends with the real Sakuya since their childhood. Contrasting Sequel Main Character: Her role of childhood friend and wanting to change Neo-Britannia from within can bring a bit of Suzaku to mind, but with the contrast of staying friends with Sakuya in spite of helping the rebellion and doing things outside of the role of combat, but also realizes that she can't change the group from within a lot earlier. Damsel in Distress: She's kept prisoner by the Neo-Britannian Empire because everyone thinks she's Sakuya, and the real Sakuya wants to save her.

characters.name: Mei Ema
characters.description: A waitress at the Sumari coffee shop. Action Survivor: Unlike Vallen she isn't combat trained, but she manages to survivethe L.O.K.I. attack until the Seven Shining Stars arrive to take out the drones. Bubbly Waitress: She's a cute waitress who has a cheerful, bubbly personality. Contrasting Sequel Main Character: Sayoko was aNinja Maid, whereas Mei isn't combat trained. Mysterious Past: How did she came to be privy of Sakuya's identity is unknown.

characters.name: Vallen Stark
characters.description: The bartender of the Sumari coffee shop. Mysterious Past: His background, reasons for supporting Sakuya, and the story behind his proficiency with weapons are never explained. Secret-Keeper: Like Mei he's aware of Sakuya's secret identity. What Happened to the Mouse?:While Mei is shown to have survived the Loki attack and continues her work as a waitress, Vallen is absent from the epilogue, although it can be assumed he survived too.

characters.name: Jugo Sumeragi
characters.description: The former governor of Hokkaido in the United States of Japan and Sakuya's late father. During Neo-Britannia's conquest of the prefecture, he was killed. Even the Loving Hero Has Hated Ones:Subverted. WhenAshasks Jugo if he hates Norland for taking over Hokkaido, Jugo admits he can't himself to hate the tyrant. He does quip that Norland is at the very bottom of a rank list of people he loves. Face Death with Dignity:When the chief guard is about to shoot him in the head, Jugo smiles and tells him to give him a quick death. Happily Married: By all accounts his marriage to Sherry me Britannia was a happy one despite the different backgrounds. Heroic Sacrifice:He told Ash to save himself after he got shot in the leg, before being gunned down by the prison guards soon after.

characters.name: Rai
characters.description: ThePlayer Characterof theVisual NovelCode Geass: Lost Colors, Rai is a mysterious young man who enters the story (approximately around Episode 8) when Milly finds him wandering around Tokyo withamnesiaand takes him to Ashford Academy. He quickly learns that he has a Geass power of his own, effectively identical to Lelouch's except that Rai's is auditory rather than visual. From there, he meets the central cast, and can choose whether to become Zero's right-hand man in the Black Knights, or Suzaku's partner in the Britannian military (or, in a PSP-exclusive storyline, he can revive the Japan Liberation Front and oppose both the Black Knights and Britannia). SeeLost Colors character page for more details on Rai. The Ace: Becomes this in either the Britannian Military/Black Knights/Japan Liberation Front Routes. Alternate Timeline:With the help of his Geass, he can prevent the special zone massacre and save Euphemia li Britannia from her death. Attractive Bent-Gender: See him dress up as a girl.

characters.name: Disel
characters.description: The Ace: Alongside Kallen, they're one of the best pilots among the Black Knights and even get their own personal custom Knightmare Frame to reflect it. Tellingly, while Kallen's code name of Q1 marks her as the Queen, Disel is labeled K1 - theKing. Ace Custom: Disel hassixpersonalized Knightmare Frames, the most featured across the franchise that aren't derivations of an existing model.They initially use a custom Burai that is specialized (gameplay-wise) for ranged combat.At Narita, they receive the Sougetsu, a derivative of the Gekka that uses a shield claw in place of the Radiant Wave Surger.After infiltrating the military, they gain a custom Sutherland that can use either a VARIS rifle or an EM Jousting Lance.Continued work with the military eventually sees their custom Sutherland upgraded into the Arondight, which has comparable performance and all the standard equipment (MVS, Blaze Luminous, VARIS, etc) of the original Lancelot.After the Arondight is destroyed during the mission over the Pacific, Kagari Savitri refurbishes the Sougetsu into the Kumui Sougetsu, which now has a electric claw weapon to pad out its arsenal.Unfortunately, it gets destroyed during the raid on the Geass Order.The endgame of R2 sees them gain the Pendulum which Disel stole from their Aunt Carly's base. It's upgraded into the Pendulum Full Arms for theFinal Battleof R2. During R3/Re;surrection, it is in a state of dis-repair from the final battle, being barely held together before being defeated by the Karla Shu Rakma. At Narita, they receive the Sougetsu, a derivative of the Gekka that uses a shield claw in place of the Radiant Wave Surger. After infiltrating the military, they gain a custom Sutherland that can use either a VARIS rifle or an EM Jousting Lance.

characters.name: Clarice Garfield
characters.description: Disel's caretaker and surrogate mother. Foil: An interesting example in that her relationship with Disel makes her a composite of the three female characters outside of the Black Knights that are the closest to Lelouch, but with her own spin on things.Clarice being Disel's surrogate mother brings to mind Sayoko's bond with Lelouch, but Clarice has none of Sayoko's combat skills and can be very caustic toward Disel if the latter gets into trouble, whereas Sayoko hasUndying Loyaltyto her charge.Being a person that Disel wants to protect above all, even as she becomes a terrorist/revolutionary, draws comparisons between Clarice and Nunnally. Clarice, however, is much more outspoken about her desire to protect Disel than Nunnally is about how she wouldn't want a gentler world if she couldn't share it with her brother. Additionally, while Nunnally needs Lelouch to help care for her, Clarice is the one caring for Disel.Finally, just like Shirley, Clarice is someone Disel refuses to share anything about her double-life with as a form of protection, with Clarice in turn getting very uncomfortable because sheknowsthat Disel is doing stuff behind her back. The main difference is that while Lelouch goes as far as wiping Shirley's memory via Geass to protect her, Clarice only finds out about Disel being a member of the Black Knights during the Black Rebellion but chooses to support them wholeheartedly. Unfortunately,Clarice ends up sharing Shirley's fate of being murdered by a member of the protagonist's family (albeit an actualLong-Lost Relativefor Disel as opposed to the backstory invader that was Rolo) due to getting in the way of the said relative'sMad Lovefor the protagonist. characters.name: Carly Disel
characters.description: The maternal aunt of Disel, and a personal friend of Charles zi Britannia. Always Someone Better: Every single encounter they have with Disel, training or real, ends with Carly having the upper hand, only to be distracted by external influences and forced to back down.It takes Disel using their most powerful Knightmare Frame, the Pendulum, and having the aid of Claudio Darlton and Sapphire Kalas to finally beat her, and the Second Black Rebellion shows that thisstilldidn't kill her. Ambiguously Gay: If we considering when Carly and her secretary Johanna Crauser are completely naked and covered only by bed sheets and Johanna remain seduced and excited, the word "ambiguously" doesn't count. Bandage Mummy:Spends the final portion of R2 covered in bandages due to the injuries she took when the Magadala was destroyed. Beneath the Mask: In public, she's kind if ratherblunt.In private, though, she'sbugfuck nuts, having killed her sister and said sister's husband during the Invasion of Japan, theneaten said sister's heart. She murdered her young niece for witnessing said event and she desecrating the corpse of her dead sister and embalming it, and she trying to emblam even Mario/Maya

characters.name: Pied Piper
characters.description: Sinister Minister: His outfit resembles a priests, and he is a terrorist who uses children as soldiers. Would Hurt a Child: He turns the children under his care into Burst Children which increases their abilities but also causes them to be turned into living bombs as well.

characters.name: Warren Azerian
characters.description: Faux Affably Evil: He acts polite towards Neha and Savitri despite holding them hostage, and when they refuse to cooperate with his demands he threatens to kill innocent children until they do. The Generalissimo: He is the military dictator of Kilania, serving as President and General of its army. President Evil: Of Kilania, being a military dictator who kidnaps Neha and Savitri to create Knightmare Frames and threatens to kill children. Would Hurt a Child: He shoots a little girl named Nura and threatens to kill her and several other children if Neha and Savitri continue to refuse his demands.

characters.name: Clara Lanfranc
characters.description: I Just Want My Beloved to Be Happy: Clara in a twisted way. I Know Your True Name: Clara Lanfranc has the Geass power totake control of peoples' bodiesif she looks them in the eye and speaks their true name.She tries using the power against "Oldrin", but it fails because it's actually Orpheus in disguise, and he's smart enough to kill her before she can give it a second chance. Un-person:Clara Lanfranc, thefirstperson the Geass Directorate sent to spy on Lelouch while pretending to be his sibling, got erased from everyones' memories after Orpheus killed her and was subsequently replaced by Rolo Haliburton.

characters.name: Characters / Code Geass - Lelouch Lamperouge
characters.description: Call-Back: Lelouch's first Geass command at the start of the first season andR2is to brainwash the attackers into committing suicide:Lelouch: Lelouch vi Britannia commands you, now all of you... die! Calling the Old Man Out: Aside from his desire to make Nunnally's dream of a kind world come true, Lelouch's main reason for basicallystarting a world warwas to do this to the Emperor. (Let it never be said that he does anything by half-measures.) Near the end of the series, he finally does it. Camp: Initially only as Zero butEmperor Lelouch gets quite campy. Cannot Spit It Out: Lelouch has a habit of dodging questions even when he'd be better off answering them. Card-Carrying Villain: Lelouch invokes thisduring his reign as Emperor deliberately playing the part of a power-hungry despot to his former friends, family and the world at large as part of theZero Requiem. El Cid Ploy: As part ofZero Requiem. The lynchpin of the operation is Suzaku taking the mantle of Zero permanently, while Lelouch takes on the role of the Emperor of Britannia. Elemental Motifs: Dark, having dark clothing as Zero, favours working from the shadows and using guile to further his seemingly impossible plans. He even made his public debut at night after saving hostages from a hotel jacking. The Emperor:The 99th Emperor of Britannia. He's more ruthless than his father ever wasbut that's all a part of the plan. Establishing Character Moment:After ordering a group of soldiers to kill themselves, Lelouch looks shocked and disturbed for a few seconds, before breaking into a smile.Another, often overlooked takes place moments earlier. The soldiers are seconds away from killing him, and he pretty much knows that he's about to die... and his final thoughts are of Nunnally.
